paragraphs.en: We decided to use time estimates determined by humans after we concluded that initial attempts with AI-based time estimates were not reliable enough. The (human) time required to complete each task was estimated immediately after its creation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出结论：最初使用基于 AI 的工时估算不够可靠，因此决定采用由人类确定的工时估算。 每个任务创建后立即估算完成该任务所需的（人类）工时。

sents.en: We decided to use time estimates determined by humans after we concluded that initial attempts with AI-based time estimates were not reliable enough.
sents.zh: 我们得出结论：最初使用基于 AI 的工时估算不够可靠，因此决定采用由人类确定的工时估算。

sents.en: The (human) time required to complete each task was estimated immediately after its creation.
sents.zh: 每个任务创建后立即估算完成该任务所需的（人类）工时。

paragraphs.en: The estimate covers the total time required to complete the task, including answering the questions and performing initial plausibility checks and quality assurance. The reference was a modeler with moderate experience—approximately 3+ years in financial modeling—who had already created similar models but might still need to double-check some more complex aspects or consult how-to sources.
paragraphs.zh: 该估算涵盖了完成任务所需的总时间，包括回答问题、进行初步合理性检查以及质量保证。 参考对象是一位具有中等经验的建模人员——在财务建模方面拥有约3年以上经验——他已经创建过类似的模型，但仍可能需要复核一些较为复杂的方面或查阅相关操作指南。

sents.en: The reference was a modeler with moderate experience—approximately 3+ years in financial modeling—who had already created similar models but might still need to double-check some more complex aspects or consult how-to sources.

paragraphs.en: For every model, the time was broken down into the following pieces:
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型，时间被分解为以下几个部分：

paragraphs.en: Reading and interpreting the instructions
paragraphs.zh: 阅读并理解指令

paragraphs.en: Understanding the structure the model should have
paragraphs.zh: 理解模型应具备的结构

paragraphs.en: Planning the layout / model architecture
paragraphs.zh: 规划布局 / 模型架构

paragraphs.en: Debugging / sense checks (initial QA before handing off to superiors)
paragraphs.zh: 调试 / 合理性检查（在交给上级之前进行的初始质量检查）

paragraphs.en: A step may also have an estimated duration of 0 minutes if it is not required for certain (particularly small) models.
paragraphs.zh: 如果某个步骤对某些（特别是小型）模型并非必需，则该步骤的估计时长也可能为 0 分钟。

paragraphs.en: The main part of the estimate—and generally the most time-consuming part—is model building. The time required for model building was estimated and broken down individually for each task. The model development process was divided into model-specific sub-steps; a time range was then estimated for each sub-step, with the average value of each range used as the basis for the time estimate, and all sub-step estimates were added together.
paragraphs.zh: 估算的主要部分——通常也是最耗时的部分——是模型构建。 模型构建所需的时间被逐一估算并分解到每个任务。 模型开发过程被划分为特定于模型的子步骤；随后为每个子步骤估算一个时间范围，以每个范围的平均值作为时间估算的依据，并将所有子步骤的估算值相加。

paragraphs.en: The following entries describe the different financial models that we created as tasks. The task type was specified directly during the creation process.
paragraphs.zh: 以下条目描述了我们作为任务创建的不同财务模型。 任务类型是在创建过程中直接指定的。

sents.en: The following entries describe the different financial models that we created as tasks.
sents.zh: 以下条目描述了我们作为任务创建的不同财务模型。

sents.en: The task type was specified directly during the creation process.
sents.zh: 任务类型是在创建过程中直接指定的。

paragraphs.en: All tasks in our benchmark were created from scratch by finance experts and are not derived from existing materials. This reduces the risk of data contamination, i.e., the risk that tasks or their solutions appear in the training data of the models underlying the evaluated agents, although the public release may expose future models to them. Each task consists of two files: an input workbook and a golden solution. The input workbook contains three or four sections on separate tabs: task instructions (analogous to a prompt), assumptions, supporting data (for some tasks only), and the questions on which the evaluation of Final calculation accuracy is based.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基准测试中的所有任务均由金融专家从零创建，并非改编自现有材料。 这降低了数据污染的风险，即任务或其解答出现在被评估智能体所依托模型的训练数据中的风险，尽管公开发布可能会使未来的模型接触到这些内容。 每个任务由两个文件组成：一个输入工作簿和一个标准答案。 输入工作簿在单独的工作表标签中包含三或四个部分：任务说明（类似于提示词）、假设条件、支持数据（仅部分任务有），以及作为最终计算准确性评估依据的问题。

sents.zh: 我们基准测试中的所有任务均由金融专家从零创建，并非改编自现有材料。

sents.en: This reduces the risk of data contamination, i.e., the risk that tasks or their solutions appear in the training data of the models underlying the evaluated agents, although the public release may expose future models to them.
sents.zh: 这降低了数据污染的风险，即任务或其解答出现在被评估智能体所依托模型的训练数据中的风险，尽管公开发布可能会使未来的模型接触到这些内容。

sents.en: The input workbook contains three or four sections on separate tabs: task instructions (analogous to a prompt), assumptions, supporting data (for some tasks only), and the questions on which the evaluation of Final calculation accuracy is based.
sents.zh: 输入工作簿在单独的工作表标签中包含三或四个部分：任务说明（类似于提示词）、假设条件、支持数据（仅部分任务有），以及作为最终计算准确性评估依据的问题。

paragraphs.en: The instructions are as detailed as necessary while remaining concise. We refined the instructions iteratively to remove the ambiguities we identified and to support a fair comparison of agents. We deliberately refrained from including examples or explicit formulas, as this would not reflect how practitioners currently formulate such requests. Where terminology or conventions are not uniformly defined in finance, we followed prevailing industry practice in both the instructions and the golden solution. None of the questions are open-ended: every question used to assess Final calculation accuracy has a single, definitive answer, which is numerical in most cases.
paragraphs.zh: 指令在保持简洁的同时具备必要的详细程度。 我们对指令进行了迭代式完善，以消除我们识别出的歧义，并支持对智能体进行公平比较。 我们刻意不包含示例或明确的公式，因为这无法反映从业者目前表述此类请求的方式。 对于金融领域中术语或惯例定义不统一之处，我们在指令和黄金解答中均遵循了行业通行做法。 所有题目均非开放式：用于评估最终计算准确性的每个问题都有唯一、确定的答案，且大多数情况下该答案为数值。

paragraphs.en: The number of accompanying assumptions varies by task type and can reach several hundred. They are provided in tabular form with clear labels and, in some cases, additional descriptions. In accordance with industry practice, we expect agents to reference these assumptions in their financial models rather than hardcode their values. Where necessary, tasks also include supporting data, such as sales prices, trading data, or financial statements; in all but a few cases, this data was generated synthetically. The questions tab, whose answer cells are left blank, is used for our main rubric criterion: Final calculation accuracy . The questions were sampled randomly across the model’s main results and, where applicable, their periods, so that they cover its different parts. Consequently, some questions are easy to answer, while others require all instructions to be implemented correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 伴随假设的数量因任务类型而异，可达数百个。 这些假设以表格形式提供，带有清晰的标签，某些情况下还附有额外说明。 依照行业惯例，我们期望智能体在其财务模型中引用这些假设，而不是将数值硬编码。 必要时，任务还会包含支持性数据，例如销售价格、交易数据或财务报表；除少数情况外，这些数据均为合成生成。 问题标签页（其中的答案单元格留空）用于我们的主要评分标准：最终计算准确性。 这些问题是从模型的主要结果中随机抽取的，并在适用的情况下涵盖其各个期间，从而覆盖模型的不同部分。 因此，有些问题容易回答，而另一些则需要正确执行所有指令。

paragraphs.en: The golden solution contains the tabs of the input workbook as well as the completed financial model. Depending on the task requirements and on what is reasonable for the model, the financial model spans one or more worksheets. In the golden solution, the questions tab contains references to the corresponding answers in the financial model and serves as the ground truth for evaluating the agents’ Final calculation accuracy . The golden solutions define the ground truth for Final calculation accuracy ; for reasons of efficiency, they are reference computations rather than presentation-ready deliverables and are therefore not graded against the remaining criteria. Their scores and pass rates therefore cannot serve as a reference for the agents’ attempts, since the golden solutions may, for instance, omit documentation or formatting that the house standards require of the agents.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金解答包含输入工作簿的各个工作表标签以及已完成的财务模型。 根据任务要求以及模型的合理情况，财务模型可跨越一个或多个工作表。 在黄金解答中，问题工作表标签包含对财务模型中相应答案的引用，并作为评估智能体的最终计算准确率的基准真值。 黄金解答定义了最终计算准确率的基准真值；出于效率考虑，它们是参考计算而非可直接交付的成品，因此不按其余标准进行评分。 因此，它们的得分和通过率不能作为智能体作答的参考，因为黄金解答可能（例如）省略了房屋标准要求智能体遵守的文档记录或格式设置。

sents.zh: 黄金解答定义了最终计算准确率的基准真值；出于效率考虑，它们是参考计算而非可直接交付的成品，因此不按其余标准进行评分。

sents.en: Their scores and pass rates therefore cannot serve as a reference for the agents’ attempts, since the golden solutions may, for instance, omit documentation or formatting that the house standards require of the agents.
sents.zh: 因此，它们的得分和通过率不能作为智能体作答的参考，因为黄金解答可能（例如）省略了房屋标准要求智能体遵守的文档记录或格式设置。

paragraphs.en: All tasks underwent a multi-stage quality assurance process. We iteratively refined the instructions and the tasks themselves to remove ambiguities, and verified the correctness of the golden solution models and answers through both human and LLM-based review. For the latter, an LLM was given the golden solution together with the instructions and asked to check whether the instructions had been implemented and the model built correctly. A task was included in the benchmark only after at least two review runs in which no errors were found.
paragraphs.zh: 所有任务均经过多阶段质量保证流程。 我们反复迭代完善指令与任务本身，以消除歧义，并通过人工审查和基于大语言模型的审查验证了黄金解答模型与答案的正确性。 对于后者，我们向大语言模型提供黄金解答以及指令，并要求其检查指令是否已被正确实现、模型是否被正确构建。 只有在至少两轮审查中均未发现错误的任务，才会被纳入基准。

paragraphs.en: Our experts comprise four people with finance training: three practitioners with industry experience and one accomplished competitor and task author in financial modeling and spreadsheet competitions. All annotators have hands-on experience building the class of models the benchmark covers; the practitioners and the competitor in particular possess notably greater spreadsheet and industry expertise. Developing the benchmark, including the rubric, the tasks, the judge, and the evaluation pipeline, took approximately 2,095 2{,}095 person-hours, excluding the agent runs themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的专家团队由四位受过金融训练的人士组成：三位拥有行业经验的从业者，以及一位在金融建模和电子表格竞赛中成绩卓著的参赛者兼赛题作者。 所有标注者都拥有构建该基准所覆盖类别模型的实际经验；尤其是那位从业者和那位参赛者，具备明显更强的电子表格和行业专业能力。 开发该基准（包括评分细则、任务、评判器和评估流水线）耗费了约 2,095 2{,}095 人时，尚不包括智能体运行本身所花费的时间。

paragraphs.en: The judge is an agentic grader built on GPT-5.6 Sol. For each grading it receives the attempt workbook, the task’s golden solution, and the input workbook, serialized sheet by sheet with openpyxl, and can read any range of any of them on demand. It is given the judge-graded criteria applicable to the task (Appendix A.1 ) and works through them in a single conversation, recording a pass or fail verdict with located mistakes for each, until every criterion has a verdict. Final calculation accuracy and 19 further criteria, such as Sufficient column widths and No hidden sheets , are not judged this way but checked deterministically (Appendix A.1 ). Grading of the remaining criteria that would typically involve observation of the rendered workbook, such as Totals visually distinguished , relies on the creation of a properties block, which is included in what the judge receives. The properties block is created by leveraging openpyxl functionality to log stored settings and metadata about the state of the workbook that is more comprehensive than just values and formulas. The judge relies on this properties block to make inferences about the formatting of the workbook. For criteria that typically would require sensitivity-testing inputs, such as No errors under extreme-but-plausible inputs , the judge must reason about the architecture of the workbook and formula structure to determine if any potential criteria violations exist.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判是基于 GPT-5.6 Sol 构建的智能体式评分器。 每次评分时，它会接收尝试工作簿、任务的黄金解法工作簿和输入工作簿，它们通过 openpyxl 按工作表逐个序列化，并且裁判可以按需读取其中任何一个的任意区域。 裁判会获得适用于该任务的由裁判评判的标准（附录 A.1），并在单次对话中逐条处理，为每条标准记录通过或失败的判定及定位的错误，直到每条标准都有判定为止。 最终计算准确性以及另外 19 条标准（例如列宽足够和没有隐藏工作表）不以这种方式评判，而是通过确定性方式检查（附录 A.1）。 对其余通常需要观察渲染后工作簿的标准（例如总计在视觉上有区分）的评分，依赖于创建一个属性块，该属性块包含在裁判所接收的内容之中。 属性块是通过利用 openpyxl 的功能来记录存储的设置和关于工作簿状态的元数据而创建的，其信息比仅有值和公式更为全面。 裁判依赖该属性块来推断工作簿的格式设置。 对于通常需要进行敏感性测试输入的标准（例如在极端但合理的输入下没有错误），裁判必须对工作簿的架构和公式结构进行推理，以判断是否存在任何潜在的标准违规。

paragraphs.en: For each of the 109 criteria graded by the judge, we constructed one pair of validation examples from a single task to which the criterion applies. Where necessary, we first modified the task’s golden solution so that it clearly satisfies the criterion; the resulting workbook is the clean example . The author of the task then derived the erroneous example by manually perturbing the clean example so that it violates the criterion. Each perturbation was designed to make the violation unambiguous, so that the correct verdict is not in doubt, but not trivially detectable, so that the judge must inspect the workbook to find it. We then ran the judge three times on each of the 218 examples, grading each only on the criterion it was built to test; Section 4.1 reports the results. Based on initial validation runs, we iteratively refined the judging setup to obtain consistent grades, for instance by adjusting which file contents the judge receives.
paragraphs.zh: 对于评判模型所评定的109项标准中的每一项，我们都从该标准适用的单个任务中构造了一对验证示例。 必要时，我们首先修改任务的标准答案，使其明确满足该标准；由此得到的工作簿即干净示例。 随后，任务作者通过手动扰动干净示例使其违反该标准，从而得出错误示例。 每次扰动的设计都旨在使违规之处毫无歧义，从而确保正确判定不存在疑问，但又不易被轻易察觉，从而要求评判模型必须检查工作簿才能发现它。 然后，我们对这218个示例分别运行评判模型三次，每个示例仅按其构建时所针对的标准进行评分；4.1节报告了结果。 基于初步验证运行，我们迭代改进了评判设置以获得一致的评分，例如调整评判模型接收哪些文件内容。

paragraphs.en: We use “harness” to mean everything around the model that a practitioner would receive as one product: the agent scaffold, its tools, how it reads and writes the workbook, its default settings, and its workflow (e.g., the Excel add-ins edit the open workbook in place). Our harness comparisons therefore measure the effect of the product as deployed, not of any single component. Note that the main claims only state the harness has an effect, and we do not attribute the resulting differences to any specific component of the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用「harness（执行环境）」指代从业者作为一个整体产品所获得的、围绕模型的一切：智能体框架、其工具、它如何读写工作簿、其默认设置以及其工作流（例如，Excel 加载项直接就地编辑打开的工作簿）。 因此，我们对 harness 的比较衡量的是部署后的产品整体效果，而不是任何单一组件的效果。 请注意，主要结论仅说明 harness 会产生影响，我们并不将由此产生的差异归因于 harness 的任何特定组件。

paragraphs.en: Every attempt starts from the task’s input workbook, the house standards (Appendix G ), and a short instruction to build the model and record its answers on the questions tab. The rubric is never shown.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试都从任务的工作簿、房屋标准（附录G）以及一段简短的指令开始，要求构建模型并将其答案记录在问题标签页上。 评分标准从不展示。

paragraphs.en: Failures of our own infrastructure (browser, container, or provider outages) are retried and not recorded. Each agent thus has one recorded attempt per task. This follows common practice in end-to-end agentic evaluation: SWE-bench [ 10 ] , WebArena [ 30 ] , OSWorld [ 25 ] , OSWorld 2.0 [ 26 ] , and SpreadsheetBench 2 [ 31 ] likewise evaluate each model once per task, as long-horizon attempts are costly to repeat. We therefore prioritized the number of agents evaluated over repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们自身基础设施的故障（浏览器、容器或提供商中断）会进行重试，且不作记录。 因此，每个智能体在每个任务中只有一次被记录的尝试。 这遵循了端到端智能体评估的常见做法：SWE-bench [ 10 ]、WebArena [ 30 ]、OSWorld [ 25 ]、OSWorld 2.0 [ 26 ] 和 SpreadsheetBench 2 [ 31 ] 同样对每个模型在每个任务中只评估一次，因为长程尝试的重复成本很高。 因此，我们优先考虑所评估的智能体数量，而非重复运行。

sents.zh: 我们自身基础设施的故障（浏览器、容器或提供商中断）会进行重试，且不作记录。

sents.en: Each agent thus has one recorded attempt per task.

sents.en: We therefore prioritized the number of agents evaluated over repeated runs.
sents.zh: 因此，我们优先考虑所评估的智能体数量，而非重复运行。

paragraphs.en: All agent attempts are saved and graded as Excel files (.xlsx, or .xlsm where macros are present). The GUI and Excel harnesses run proprietary products that expose no version identifiers; we therefore record the date of every attempt and release these dates with the benchmark, so results for these harnesses are dated snapshots of the products. We evaluate models in several harnesses only to identify whether effects of model and harness exist, not to claim that the effect of any component is consistent and transferable (likely not the case, since model and harnesses are inherently coupled). Note that when Gemini 3.8 Flash performs poorly in Codex, we do not conclude from this single result that the model itself is weak. Instead, we rely on the observation that Gemini 3.8 Flash passes no task in either of the two harnesses it was evaluated in.
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体尝试都会以 Excel 文件（.xlsx，含宏时为 .xlsm）保存并评分。 GUI 与 Excel 智能体运行的是不公开版本标识的商业产品；因此我们记录每次尝试的日期，并随基准一起发布这些日期，这些智能体的结果是产品在相应日期的快照。 我们在若干智能体中评估模型，只是为了确定模型与智能体是否存在影响，并非声称任一组件的影响是一致且可迁移的（很可能并非如此，因为模型与智能体本质上是相互耦合的）。 请注意，当 Gemini 3.8 Flash 在 Codex 中表现不佳时，我们并不因这一单项结果而断定该模型本身很弱。 相反，我们依据的观察是：Gemini 3.8 Flash 在其接受评估的两个智能体中均未通过任何任务。

paragraphs.en: A Chrome session logged into the consumer product is controlled programmatically: upload the task files, set the mode and reasoning effort, send the prompt, wait for the reply, download the produced workbook. The products’ usage caps are respected by pausing runs; a reply that is a quota message rather than a workbook is treated as an infrastructure failure and retried.
paragraphs.zh: 一个已登录消费级产品的 Chrome 会话由程序控制：上传任务文件，设置模式和推理力度，发送提示词，等待回复，下载生成的工作簿。 通过暂停运行来遵守产品的用量上限；如果回复是配额提示消息而非工作簿，则被视为基础设施故障并进行重试。

sents.en: A Chrome session logged into the consumer product is controlled programmatically: upload the task files, set the mode and reasoning effort, send the prompt, wait for the reply, download the produced workbook.
sents.zh: 一个已登录消费级产品的 Chrome 会话由程序控制：上传任务文件，设置模式和推理力度，发送提示词，等待回复，下载生成的工作簿。

sents.en: The products’ usage caps are respected by pausing runs; a reply that is a quota message rather than a workbook is treated as an infrastructure failure and retried.
sents.zh: 通过暂停运行来遵守产品的用量上限；如果回复是配额提示消息而非工作簿，则被视为基础设施故障并进行重试。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic models are run in Claude Code. OpenAI and all other models with the exception of Anthropic models are run in Codex. Claude Code and Codex run non-interactively inside a pinned container image with a firewall that resolves only the vendor’s API endpoint. The container holds the task files and the prompt as a text file; the agent may install and run any code it likes, and the image ships LibreOffice for formula recalculation. Reasoning effort is pinned per agent at the highest tier the product offers for that model. We recognize that Codex is likely tuned for OpenAI’s models. However, we note that our main claim is not that each harness has a specific and consistent effect, but merely that it has an effect, so this tuning does not constitute a confounding factor. For the same reason, running Anthropic models in Claude Code and all other models in Codex is not a confound, since we compare harnesses only on the same model.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 模型在 Claude Code 中运行。 除 Anthropic 模型之外，OpenAI 及所有其他模型均在 Codex 中运行。 Claude Code 和 Codex 在一个固定版本的容器镜像内以非交互方式运行，该容器的防火墙仅允许解析供应商的 API 端点。 容器中存放着任务文件和以文本文件形式提供的提示词；智能体可以随意安装并运行任何代码，镜像中还内置了 LibreOffice 用于公式重新计算。 推理力度按智能体分别固定在该产品为相应模型所提供的最高档位。 我们承认 Codex 很可能是针对 OpenAI 的模型进行过调优的。 然而，我们指出，我们的主要主张并不是每个运行框架都具有特定且一致的效果，而仅仅是它会产生影响，因此这种调优并不构成混杂因素。 出于同样的原因，让 Anthropic 模型在 Claude Code 中运行、让所有其他模型在 Codex 中运行也不是混杂因素，因为我们对运行框架的比较仅在同一模型上进行。

sents.zh: Anthropic 模型在 Claude Code 中运行。

sents.en: OpenAI and all other models with the exception of Anthropic models are run in Codex.
sents.zh: 除 Anthropic 模型之外，OpenAI 及所有其他模型均在 Codex 中运行。

sents.en: However, we note that our main claim is not that each harness has a specific and consistent effect, but merely that it has an effect, so this tuning does not constitute a confounding factor.

paragraphs.en: In the web-based version of Microsoft Excel, Excel Online, the pipeline opens a copy of the task’s input workbook, opens the add-in panel offered by Anthropic or OpenAI, selects and verifies the model or reasoning-effort setting, attaches the remaining task files with the first prompt, and downloads the workbook the add-in edited in place. It is the only harness in which the agent works directly inside the spreadsheet application.
paragraphs.zh: 在微软 Excel 的网页版 Excel Online 中，该流程会打开任务输入工作簿的副本，打开 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 提供的加载项面板，选择并验证模型或推理力度设置，将剩余任务文件与第一条提示词一起附上，并下载该加载项就地编辑后的工作簿。 这是唯一一个智能体直接在电子表格应用程序内部工作的测试框架。

sents.en: In the web-based version of Microsoft Excel, Excel Online, the pipeline opens a copy of the task’s input workbook, opens the add-in panel offered by Anthropic or OpenAI, selects and verifies the model or reasoning-effort setting, attaches the remaining task files with the first prompt, and downloads the workbook the add-in edited in place.

sents.en: It is the only harness in which the agent works directly inside the spreadsheet application.
sents.zh: 这是唯一一个智能体直接在电子表格应用程序内部工作的测试框架。

paragraphs.en: This harness was built by the research team. A single loop calls the model’s API with 21 spreadsheet tools (file, worksheet, cell and formula edits, formatting, structure inspection, search); every formula edit triggers a LibreOffice recalculation whose results are returned to the model. Each attempt is capped at 40 model calls to limit inference cost. The API endpoints integrated into the harness include Anthropic, OpenAI, and TensorBlock. Third-party libraries such as openpyxl are used to extract and serialize the spreadsheet data in a CSV format, which is fed to the LLM API. The prompt is included in the input sent to the API.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试框架由研究团队构建。 单个循环通过21个电子表格工具（文件、工作表、单元格和公式编辑、格式设置、结构检查、搜索）调用模型的API；每次公式编辑都会触发一次LibreOffice重新计算，其结果会返回给模型。 每次尝试最多调用模型40次，以限制推理成本。 集成到该测试框架中的API端点包括Anthropic、OpenAI和TensorBlock。 使用openpyxl等第三方库提取电子表格数据并将其序列化为CSV格式，再输入给LLM API。 提示词包含在发送给API的输入中。

sents.zh: 该测试框架由研究团队构建。

sents.zh: 每次尝试最多调用模型40次，以限制推理成本。

sents.en: The API endpoints integrated into the harness include Anthropic, OpenAI, and TensorBlock.
sents.zh: 集成到该测试框架中的API端点包括Anthropic、OpenAI和TensorBlock。

sents.en: Third-party libraries such as openpyxl are used to extract and serialize the spreadsheet data in a CSV format, which is fed to the LLM API.

paragraphs.en: This section describes patterns that apply to multiple agents, harnesses, or difficulty levels, rather than to individual agents; agents are mentioned by name only as examples. It covers the 14 main agent–harness combinations at the highest reasoning-effort setting on all 101 101 tasks, graded with the full rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍适用于多个智能体、测试框架或难度级别的模式，而非针对单个智能体的模式；智能体仅作为示例被提及。 它涵盖了在最高推理力度设置下、在全部 101 101 个任务上使用完整评分细则进行评估的 14 种主要智能体–测试框架组合。

sents.en: This section describes patterns that apply to multiple agents, harnesses, or difficulty levels, rather than to individual agents; agents are mentioned by name only as examples.
sents.zh: 本节介绍适用于多个智能体、测试框架或难度级别的模式，而非针对单个智能体的模式；智能体仅作为示例被提及。

sents.en: It covers the 14 main agent–harness combinations at the highest reasoning-effort setting on all 101 101 tasks, graded with the full rubric.
sents.zh: 它涵盖了在最高推理力度设置下、在全部 101 101 个任务上使用完整评分细则进行评估的 14 种主要智能体–测试框架组合。

paragraphs.en: Agents usually build structurally sound models, and their structural completeness holds even on the hardest tasks. What falls with difficulty is correctness: agents hand in complete, tidy workbooks with more wrong answers. The integrity checks created by the agents tend to verify internal consistency rather than plausibility; industry-standard presentation conventions are applied inconsistently; and more complex tasks result in large, deeply nested workbooks. Finally, the harness also plays a role: while the Claude models in Claude for Excel match their Claude Cowork counterparts on answers but lose scaffolding and polish, the frontier models in the Code harness match their GUI counterparts of the same models on answers and score, though not necessarily on pass rate.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通常能构建结构上健全的模型，即使在最困难的任务上其结构完整性也能保持。 真正难以保障的是正确性：智能体提交的完整、整洁的工作簿中包含更多错误答案。 智能体创建的完整性检查往往验证的是内部一致性而非合理性；行业标准的呈现规范未能得到一致应用；而更复杂的任务则会产生庞大且深度嵌套的工作簿。 最后，运行框架也起到一定作用：Claude for Excel 中的 Claude 模型在答案上与它们的 Claude Cowork 对应版本相当，但在脚手架和润色方面有所欠缺；而 Code 框架中的前沿模型在答案和得分上与同模型的 GUI 对应版本相当，但不一定在通过率上相当。

sents.en: Agents usually build structurally sound models, and their structural completeness holds even on the hardest tasks.
sents.zh: 智能体通常能构建结构上健全的模型，即使在最困难的任务上其结构完整性也能保持。

sents.en: What falls with difficulty is correctness: agents hand in complete, tidy workbooks with more wrong answers.
sents.zh: 真正难以保障的是正确性：智能体提交的完整、整洁的工作簿中包含更多错误答案。

sents.en: The integrity checks created by the agents tend to verify internal consistency rather than plausibility; industry-standard presentation conventions are applied inconsistently; and more complex tasks result in large, deeply nested workbooks.
sents.zh: 智能体创建的完整性检查往往验证的是内部一致性而非合理性；行业标准的呈现规范未能得到一致应用；而更复杂的任务则会产生庞大且深度嵌套的工作簿。

sents.en: Finally, the harness also plays a role: while the Claude models in Claude for Excel match their Claude Cowork counterparts on answers but lose scaffolding and polish, the frontier models in the Code harness match their GUI counterparts of the same models on answers and score, though not necessarily on pass rate.
sents.zh: 最后，运行框架也起到一定作用：Claude for Excel 中的 Claude 模型在答案上与它们的 Claude Cowork 对应版本相当，但在脚手架和润色方面有所欠缺；而 Code 框架中的前沿模型在答案和得分上与同模型的 GUI 对应版本相当，但不一定在通过率上相当。

paragraphs.en: Agents deliver spreadsheets with live, driver-based formulas, correctly anchored references, centralized assumptions, and a cover stating the model’s purpose. This structural completeness holds as tasks get harder: the agents keep handing in complete workbooks with live answers, proper roll-forwards, and dedicated check rows, and blank answer sheets remain rare at every difficulty level.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体交付的电子表格包含基于驱动因素的实时公式、正确锚定的引用、集中管理的假设，以及说明模型用途的封面。 这种结构上的完整性在任务变得更难时依然保持：智能体持续提交包含实时答案、正确结转和专门核对行的完整工作簿，而空白答卷在各个难度级别都很少出现。

sents.en: Agents deliver spreadsheets with live, driver-based formulas, correctly anchored references, centralized assumptions, and a cover stating the model’s purpose.
sents.zh: 智能体交付的电子表格包含基于驱动因素的实时公式、正确锚定的引用、集中管理的假设，以及说明模型用途的封面。

sents.en: This structural completeness holds as tasks get harder: the agents keep handing in complete workbooks with live answers, proper roll-forwards, and dedicated check rows, and blank answer sheets remain rare at every difficulty level.
sents.zh: 这种结构上的完整性在任务变得更难时依然保持：智能体持续提交包含实时答案、正确结转和专门核对行的完整工作簿，而空白答卷在各个难度级别都很少出现。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy is highest when a task is based on well-known mechanics: bond pricing, NAV roll-ups, comparables, ratio and budget-versus-actuals analysis, and rule-based non-financial tasks. Here, most agents answer all or nearly all questions correctly, even on Hard tasks; on the Hard task LogisticsCategorization (task 34), for example, the stored answers of every agent match the golden solution.
paragraphs.zh: 当任务基于众所周知的机制时，准确率最高：债券定价、净资产值（NAV）汇总、可比公司分析、比率与预算执行差异分析，以及基于规则的非财务任务。 在这里，大多数智能体能正确回答全部或几乎全部问题，即使在困难任务上也是如此；例如，在困难任务 LogisticsCategorization（任务 34）上，每个智能体存储的答案都与黄金标准答案一致。

sents.en: Accuracy is highest when a task is based on well-known mechanics: bond pricing, NAV roll-ups, comparables, ratio and budget-versus-actuals analysis, and rule-based non-financial tasks.
sents.zh: 当任务基于众所周知的机制时，准确率最高：债券定价、净资产值（NAV）汇总、可比公司分析、比率与预算执行差异分析，以及基于规则的非财务任务。

sents.en: Here, most agents answer all or nearly all questions correctly, even on Hard tasks; on the Hard task LogisticsCategorization (task 34), for example, the stored answers of every agent match the golden solution.
sents.zh: 在这里，大多数智能体能正确回答全部或几乎全部问题，即使在困难任务上也是如此；例如，在困难任务 LogisticsCategorization（任务 34）上，每个智能体存储的答案都与黄金标准答案一致。

paragraphs.en: Agents routinely open the workbook with a cover page or summary that outlines the purpose of the model and the business question and explains the methodology. They use clear and descriptive tab names. A reader who did not build the model can therefore find their way around without a walkthrough. A live, formula-based output summary is consistently produced by the GUI agents, the Excel add-ins, and the two frontier coding agents, whereas the other Codex agents often leave it as hardcoded text.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通常会以一个封面页或摘要页打开工作簿，概述模型的目的和业务问题，并解释其方法论。 它们使用清晰且具有描述性的工作表标签名称。 因此，未参与构建模型的读者无需引导讲解也能自行找到方向。 GUI 智能体、Excel 加载项以及两个前沿编程智能体始终都能生成基于公式的动态输出摘要，而其他 Codex 智能体则常常将其留作硬编码文本。

sents.en: Agents routinely open the workbook with a cover page or summary that outlines the purpose of the model and the business question and explains the methodology.
sents.zh: 智能体通常会以一个封面页或摘要页打开工作簿，概述模型的目的和业务问题，并解释其方法论。

sents.en: They use clear and descriptive tab names.
sents.zh: 它们使用清晰且具有描述性的工作表标签名称。

sents.en: A reader who did not build the model can therefore find their way around without a walkthrough.
sents.zh: 因此，未参与构建模型的读者无需引导讲解也能自行找到方向。

sents.en: A live, formula-based output summary is consistently produced by the GUI agents, the Excel add-ins, and the two frontier coding agents, whereas the other Codex agents often leave it as hardcoded text.
sents.zh: GUI 智能体、Excel 加载项以及两个前沿编程智能体始终都能生成基于公式的动态输出摘要，而其他 Codex 智能体则常常将其留作硬编码文本。

paragraphs.en: Workbooks rarely contain hidden or sensitive elements: no external links, no hidden sheets or rows, and no white-on-white text. They keep one sign convention and one unit scale throughout and often document the convention; monetary blocks carry $k, $m, or USD tags, and scale conversions are explicit. This reduces common causes of hidden errors and order-of-magnitude errors when a model is shared with another user.
paragraphs.zh: 工作簿很少包含隐藏或敏感元素：没有外部链接，没有隐藏的工作表或行，也没有白底白字。 全文始终使用一种符号约定和一种单位量级，并且通常会记录该约定；货币区块带有 $k、$m 或 USD 标签，量级换算是明确写出的。 当模型共享给其他用户时，这减少了隐藏错误和数量级错误的常见成因。

sents.en: Workbooks rarely contain hidden or sensitive elements: no external links, no hidden sheets or rows, and no white-on-white text.
sents.zh: 工作簿很少包含隐藏或敏感元素：没有外部链接，没有隐藏的工作表或行，也没有白底白字。

sents.en: They keep one sign convention and one unit scale throughout and often document the convention; monetary blocks carry $k, $m, or USD tags, and scale conversions are explicit.
sents.zh: 全文始终使用一种符号约定和一种单位量级，并且通常会记录该约定；货币区块带有 $k、$m 或 USD 标签，量级换算是明确写出的。

sents.en: This reduces common causes of hidden errors and order-of-magnitude errors when a model is shared with another user.
sents.zh: 当模型共享给其他用户时，这减少了隐藏错误和数量级错误的常见成因。

paragraphs.en: Nearly every agent ships a dedicated check sheet of formula-driven pass/fail rows. The rows are typically summarized under a master error flag on the cover page or in the summary. The weak point is the roll-up: a COUNTIF summary over the status column skips rows with errors, causing the master error flag to show “OK” even though the checks fail. Such checks allow an auditor to immediately verify internal consistency, but a false “all clear” finding is worse for a client than no feedback at all.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个智能体都会附带一份专门的检查表，其中包含由公式驱动的通过/不通过行。 这些行通常在封面页或汇总部分通过一个总错误标志进行汇总。 弱点在于汇总环节：对状态列使用 COUNTIF 的汇总方式会跳过含错误的行，导致总错误标志即使在校验失败时仍显示“正常”。 这类检查能让审计人员立即验证内部一致性，但对客户而言，一个错误的“全部通过”结论比没有任何反馈更糟糕。

sents.en: Nearly every agent ships a dedicated check sheet of formula-driven pass/fail rows.
sents.zh: 几乎每个智能体都会附带一份专门的检查表，其中包含由公式驱动的通过/不通过行。

sents.en: The rows are typically summarized under a master error flag on the cover page or in the summary.
sents.zh: 这些行通常在封面页或汇总部分通过一个总错误标志进行汇总。

sents.en: The weak point is the roll-up: a COUNTIF summary over the status column skips rows with errors, causing the master error flag to show “OK” even though the checks fail.
sents.zh: 弱点在于汇总环节：对状态列使用 COUNTIF 的汇总方式会跳过含错误的行，导致总错误标志即使在校验失败时仍显示“正常”。

sents.en: Such checks allow an auditor to immediately verify internal consistency, but a false “all clear” finding is worse for a client than no feedback at all.
sents.zh: 这类检查能让审计人员立即验证内部一致性，但对客户而言，一个错误的“全部通过”结论比没有任何反馈更糟糕。

paragraphs.en: Agents consistently follow the basic visual guidelines for a financial model: hardcoded values in blue font, often on a pale background fill; thousands separators for large numbers; a uniform format for similar values; shaded title and header areas; and totals in bold.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体始终遵循财务模型的基本视觉准则：硬编码的数值使用蓝色字体，通常带有浅色背景填充；大数字使用千位分隔符；相似的数值使用统一格式；标题和表头区域添加底纹；合计使用粗体。

paragraphs.en: Timelines are often tailored precisely to the length specified in the instructions, with a fixed number of rows or columns or a base year incorporated into the timeline formulas, so that any reasonable change in duration, start date, or rate results in the model being shortened or in errors. The problem rarely occurs with Easy tasks but becomes common from the Medium level onward. It follows the model more than the harness: Kimi K3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash in Codex often fix the horizon, and Fable 5.1 in Claude Code and Claude Cowork sometimes does, whereas GPT-6 in ChatGPT Pro, GPT-6 Astra in Codex, GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT for Excel, and Opus 5 in Claude Cowork usually drive it from one anchor date. This matters in practice, because models are routinely rerun with new data and conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 时间线往往被精确地定制为指令中指定的长度，包含固定数量的行或列，或将基准年份直接写入时间线公式中，因此任何对时长、起始日期或比率的合理改动都会导致模型被缩短或出现错误。 这个问题在简单（Easy）任务中很少出现，但从中等（Medium）难度开始就变得常见。 这更多取决于模型而非运行环境：Codex 中的 Kimi K3 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash 常常把时间范围固定下来，Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 中的 Fable 5.1 有时也会这样，而 ChatGPT Pro 中的 GPT-6、Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT for Excel 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol 以及 Claude Cowork 中的 Opus 5 通常会从一个锚定日期推算时间范围。 这在实践中很重要，因为模型经常需要在新的数据和条件下重新运行。

sents.zh: 这更多取决于模型而非运行环境：Codex 中的 Kimi K3 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash 常常把时间范围固定下来，Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 中的 Fable 5.1 有时也会这样，而 ChatGPT Pro 中的 GPT-6、Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra、ChatGPT for Excel 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol 以及 Claude Cowork 中的 Opus 5 通常会从一个锚定日期推算时间范围。

paragraphs.en: Workbooks are built for the agent, not for a reader who flips through them, prints them out, and forwards them. Long schedules routinely ship without freeze panes or with so many rows frozen that they fill most of the screen (Figure 11 ), page breaks are rarely set outside the GPT-6 and GPT-6 Astra agents, and print areas are often missing. On the long timelines of harder tasks, period columns are left too narrow, so whole blocks later display balances as ### (Figure 12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工作簿是为智能体构建的，而不是为那些会翻阅、打印并转发它们的读者构建的。 长时间表经常在没有冻结窗格的情况下交付，或者冻结的行太多以至于占据了大部分屏幕（Figure 11），除 GPT-6 和 GPT-6 Astra 智能体外，分页符很少被设置，打印区域也常常缺失。 在较难任务的长时间线上，期间列被留得过窄，因此之后整块区域都会把余额显示为 ###（Figure 12）。

sents.en: Workbooks are built for the agent, not for a reader who flips through them, prints them out, and forwards them.
sents.zh: 工作簿是为智能体构建的，而不是为那些会翻阅、打印并转发它们的读者构建的。

sents.en: Long schedules routinely ship without freeze panes or with so many rows frozen that they fill most of the screen (Figure 11 ), page breaks are rarely set outside the GPT-6 and GPT-6 Astra agents, and print areas are often missing.

sents.en: On the long timelines of harder tasks, period columns are left too narrow, so whole blocks later display balances as ### (Figure 12 ).
sents.zh: 在较难任务的长时间线上，期间列被留得过窄，因此之后整块区域都会把余额显示为 ###（Figure 12）。

paragraphs.en: Most agents add a block labeled “Sense Checks”, but in almost all cases, the financial model is only validated against itself: the results are compared with the underlying assumptions or with trivial constraints that any functioning model satisfies. While these blocks confirm the arithmetic, they say nothing about plausibility; therefore, a workbook can pass every test and still yield an implausible valuation or cash position.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数智能体会添加一个标记为「合理性检查」的模块，但在几乎所有情况下，财务模型只是与自身进行验证：将结果与底层假设或任何正常运行的模型都能满足的简单约束进行比较。 虽然这些模块可以确认算术运算的正确性，但对合理性却只字未提；因此，一个工作簿可以通过所有测试，却仍然得出不合理可信的估值或现金头寸。

paragraphs.en: Important input fields are rarely protected in a way that actually prevents incorrect entries. Although the GUI agents and most other agents in the Code harness add data validation rules, they disable error warnings, so the cell accepts any value; the Excel add-ins leave the warnings enabled but either skip validation or limit it to drop-down menus, thereby ignoring dates, interest rates, and maturities; and the weakest coding-CLI model does not add any validation at all. Named ranges for global drivers are also rare outside a few agents.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的输入字段很少受到真正能防止错误输入的保护。 尽管 Code 环境中的 GUI 智能体和大多数其他智能体会添加数据验证规则，但它们会禁用错误警告，因此单元格接受任何值；Excel 加载项保留了警告，但要么跳过验证，要么将其限制在下拉菜单中，从而忽略了日期、利率和期限；而最弱的编码 CLI 模型则完全没有添加任何验证。 针对全局驱动因素的命名区域除少数智能体外也很少见。

paragraphs.en: Nearly every agent uses the convention of blue, black, and green and documents it in a legend, but the distinction between black (calculations on the same sheet) and green (references to other sheets) drifts within a sheet (Figure 13 ). Once the color no longer corresponds to the cell type, a reviewer can no longer use it to track relationships, and a legend that contradicts the worksheet or is used inconsistently is more misleading than no legend at all.
paragraphs.zh: 几乎每个智能体都使用蓝色、黑色和绿色的约定，并在图例中加以说明，但黑色（同一工作表内的计算）与绿色（对其他工作表的引用）之间的区分在同一工作表内会发生漂移（图 13）。 一旦颜色不再与单元格类型相对应，审阅者就无法再利用它来追踪关系，而与工作表相矛盾或使用不一致的图例，比没有图例更具误导性。

paragraphs.en: The basic number formatting is mostly correct, but each agent occasionally violates the financial presentation rules: negative numbers are displayed with a minus sign instead of in parentheses (Figure 14 ), exact zeros are shown as 0.00 instead of as a dash, and blocks of numbers are centered or left-aligned instead of right-aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 基本的数字格式大部分是正确的，但每个智能体偶尔会违反财务呈现规则：负数显示为带负号而不是用括号（图 14 ），精确的零显示为 0.00 而不是短横线，且数字块采用居中或左对齐而不是右对齐。

paragraphs.en: Starting with Medium-Hard tasks, the agents incorporate the logic into long single-cell formulas instead of helper rows and build brute-force engines; for example, Claude Cowork (Fable 5.1) answered the Hard task FixedDetailed (task 84, attempt 1624) correctly, but with nested IF, SUMIFS, and INDEX formulas across roughly 150,000 cells. Such models are not only inefficient but also very hard to review. At the same time, formula notes and output summaries become less frequent, and the answer cells of workbooks built in the Code harness increasingly display errors such as #NAME? or #VALUE!.
paragraphs.zh: 从中高难度任务开始，智能体们将逻辑写入冗长的单单元格公式而不使用辅助行，并构建暴力求解引擎；例如，Claude Cowork（Fable 5.1）正确回答了困难任务 FixedDetailed（任务 84，尝试 1624），但使用了嵌套的 IF、SUMIFS 和 INDEX 公式，覆盖约 150,000 个单元格。 这样的模型不仅效率低下，而且非常难以审查。 与此同时，公式备注和输出摘要变得越来越少，而在 Code 框架下构建的工作簿的答案单元格中越来越多地显示诸如 #NAME? 或 #VALUE! 之类的错误。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the strengths and weaknesses of selected models; patterns shared by nearly all agents are described in Appendix J and are not repeated. Note that we focus our attention mostly on models actually performant on the benchmark, and this section is not meant to review all agents. The points are selective: each describes one of the most pronounced strengths or weaknesses of a model, measured against the model’s own profile, against the other agents, or both. They are therefore not a ranking across models: a Good point for a lower-ranked model does not necessarily mean that it does better on that point than a higher-ranked model, unless the text says so explicitly. Likewise, a point that is not listed for a model or harness does not mean that the model is free of that weakness or lacks that strength there, only that it is not among the model’s most pronounced traits. For models run in more than one harness, the parentheses after each point name the harnesses in which the model stands out on that point; the point may also apply to the other harnesses, only less prominently. A concluding paragraph then separates the effects of the model from those of the harness: we attribute a pattern to the model if it stands out in several harnesses or if other models in the same harness behave differently, and to the harness only if the same model demonstrably behaves differently in another harness or if all models in that harness share the pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 本节描述若干选定模型的优点与缺点；几乎所有智能体共有的模式在附录 J 中描述，此处不再重复。 请注意，我们主要关注在基准测试中实际表现出色的模型，本节并非旨在评述所有智能体。 这些要点是有选择性的：每一点都描述某个模型最突出的优点或缺点之一，评判依据是该模型自身的表现特征、与其他智能体的对比，或两者兼有。 因此它们并不是跨模型的排名：某个排名较低的模型的 Good（优点）要点，并不必然意味着它在该要点上优于排名较高的模型，除非文中明确如此说明。 同样，某个模型或 harness（运行框架）未列出某一点，并不意味着该模型没有那个缺点或缺少那个优点，只是那一点不属于该模型最突出的特征。 对于在多个 harness（运行框架）中运行的模型，每个要点后的括号中列出该模型在这一点上表现突出的 harness（运行框架）；该要点也可能适用于其他 harness（运行框架），只是不那么突出。 随后的总结段落将模型的影响与 harness（运行框架）的影响区分开来：如果某个模式在多个 harness（运行框架）中都突出，或者同一 harness（运行框架）中的其他模型表现不同，我们将其归因于模型；只有当同一模型在另一个 harness（运行框架）中明显表现不同，或者该 harness（运行框架）中的所有模型都共有这一模式时，我们才将其归因于 harness（运行框架）。

paragraphs.en: In Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Fable 5.1 is narrowly the most accurate model in the field and the one most likely to test its outputs against outside benchmarks, and it delivers well-sourced, well-documented workbooks. In Claude for Excel, it answers nearly as accurately and builds some of the leanest engines in the field, but it falls behind on finishing. Its weak spots are oversized text columns and rows, “rounded to” notes on figures that are only formatted, copied engines and deeply nested formulas, and timelines that are less flexible than those of the other leading agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 中，Fable 5.1 是该领域准确率最高的模型（优势微弱），也是最倾向于用外部基准检验其输出的模型，并且它能交付来源可靠、文档完备的工作簿。 在 Claude for Excel 中，它的回答准确度几乎相当，并能构建该领域一些最精简的引擎，但在收尾完成度上落后。 它的弱点包括：过大的文本列和行、对仅做了格式化的数字标注“四舍五入至”、被复制的引擎和深层嵌套公式，以及时间线不如其他领先智能体灵活。

paragraphs.en: Sense checks against outside benchmarks (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model adds a sense-check block to its check sheet that tests headline outputs, such as margins, coverage ratios, or bond prices, against explicit external or judgment ranges, often with an owner and a date, whereas nearly every other model only reconciles its outputs with its own inputs. However, the ranges are sometimes still derived from the financial model’s own inputs. In the task CashNiagara (Claude Code, task 7, attempt 1874), debt service, distributions, interest, cash, and repayments are compared with explicit judgment ranges, and in the task DoctorvsTrade (Claude Cowork, task 18, attempt 1327), the tax, debt, savings, net worth, and crossover outputs are checked against explicit benchmark ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 与外部基准进行合理性检验（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。 模型会在其检查表中添加一个合理性检验模块，将标题性输出（如利润率、覆盖倍数或债券价格）与明确的外部或判断区间进行对照，通常还带有责任人和日期；而几乎所有其他模型只会将其输出与自身输入进行对账。 然而，这些区间有时仍来源于财务模型自身的输入。 在任务 CashNiagara（Claude Code，任务 7，第 1874 次尝试）中，偿债、分配、利息、现金和还款与明确的判断区间进行了比较；在任务 DoctorvsTrade（Claude Cowork，任务 18，第 1327 次尝试）中，税务、债务、储蓄、净资产和交叉点输出则与明确的基准区间进行了核对。

sents.en: Sense checks against outside benchmarks (Claude Code, Claude Cowork).
sents.zh: 与外部基准进行合理性检验（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。

sents.en: The model adds a sense-check block to its check sheet that tests headline outputs, such as margins, coverage ratios, or bond prices, against explicit external or judgment ranges, often with an owner and a date, whereas nearly every other model only reconciles its outputs with its own inputs.
sents.zh: 模型会在其检查表中添加一个合理性检验模块，将标题性输出（如利润率、覆盖倍数或债券价格）与明确的外部或判断区间进行对照，通常还带有责任人和日期；而几乎所有其他模型只会将其输出与自身输入进行对账。

sents.en: However, the ranges are sometimes still derived from the financial model’s own inputs.
sents.zh: 然而，这些区间有时仍来源于财务模型自身的输入。

sents.en: In the task CashNiagara (Claude Code, task 7, attempt 1874), debt service, distributions, interest, cash, and repayments are compared with explicit judgment ranges, and in the task DoctorvsTrade (Claude Cowork, task 18, attempt 1327), the tax, debt, savings, net worth, and crossover outputs are checked against explicit benchmark ranges.
sents.zh: 在任务 CashNiagara（Claude Code，任务 7，第 1874 次尝试）中，偿债、分配、利息、现金和还款与明确的判断区间进行了比较；在任务 DoctorvsTrade（Claude Cowork，任务 18，第 1327 次尝试）中，税务、债务、储蓄、净资产和交叉点输出则与明确的基准区间进行了核对。

paragraphs.en: Sourced assumptions and documented formulas (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model cites a source for almost every input, either a cell of the input workbook or the relevant part of the task instructions, gives its own judgment calls an owner and a date, and explains non-obvious formulas in cell comments or adjacent methodology notes. For example, in the task PlasticParts (Claude Code, task 43, attempt 1495), every input cites its location in the input workbook or the task instructions, and every judgment input names an owner and a date; in the task HouseorFlat (task 86), both Claude Code (attempt 1861) and Claude Cowork (attempt 1625) explain their complex formulas in comments or adjacent methodology rows.
paragraphs.zh: 有来源的假设和有文档记录的公式（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。 该模型几乎为每一项输入都引用了来源，要么是输入工作簿中的某个单元格，要么是任务说明中的相关部分，给自己的判断决定标注了责任人和日期，并在单元格批注或相邻的方法说明中解释了不显而易见的公式。 例如，在任务 PlasticParts（Claude Code，任务 43，尝试 1495）中，每一项输入都引用了其在输入工作簿或任务说明中的位置，每一项判断性输入都注明了责任人和日期；在任务 HouseorFlat（任务 86）中，Claude Code（尝试 1861）和 Claude Cowork（尝试 1625）都在批注或相邻的方法行中解释了它们的复杂公式。

paragraphs.en: Named key inputs (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model gives key global drivers, such as the anchor date, tax rate, and case selector, self-explanatory defined names and uses them in its formulas. This is evident in the task BasicGrowth (Claude Cowork, task 2, attempt 1268), where the Name Manager lists Anchor_Date , Tax_Rate , Model_Years , and Case_Selected , and in the task TheLiquidityLoop (Claude Code, task 62, attempt 1814), where the key drivers are named and their input cells validated.
paragraphs.zh: 命名的关键输入（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。 模型为关键全局驱动因素（如锚定日期、税率、案例选择器）赋予了自解释的定义名称，并在公式中使用它们。 这在任务 BasicGrowth（Claude Cowork，任务 2，尝试 1268）中表现明显，其名称管理器列出了 Anchor_Date、Tax_Rate、Model_Years 和 Case_Selected；同样在任务 TheLiquidityLoop（Claude Code，任务 62，尝试 1814）中也是如此，其中关键驱动因素被命名且其输入单元格经过验证。

paragraphs.en: Self-documenting workbooks with a master error flag (Claude Code). The workbook opens with a genuine cover stating purpose, owner, version, scope, and usage, followed by a hyperlinked table of contents, and it includes all standard components through to the checks and the change log; the check sheet rolls up into a formula-linked master error flag on the cover or summary that turns red on failure. In the task CustomerConcentration (Claude Code, task 12, attempt 1876), for instance, the cover gives title, purpose, version, date, owner, scope, approach, usage, and a legend, and in the task FiveAutomotive (Claude Code, task 22, attempt 1775), the flags on both the cover and the summary link to the check sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 自文档化的工作簿，带主错误标志（Claude Code）。 工作簿开头是一个真实的封面，注明用途、所有者、版本、范围和使用方法，随后是带超链接的目录，并包含所有标准组件直至核对项和变更日志；核对表汇总到封面或摘要上一个由公式链接的主错误标志，失败时显示为红色。 例如，在任务 CustomerConcentration（Claude Code，任务 12，尝试 1876）中，封面给出了标题、用途、版本、日期、所有者、范围、方法、使用方法和图例；而在任务 FiveAutomotive（Claude Code，任务 22，尝试 1775）中，封面和摘要上的标志都链接到核对表。

paragraphs.en: Freeze panes and print areas (Claude Code, Claude for Excel). The model freezes the headers of long sheets at sensible positions without freezing too much, and Claude Code also defines print areas on every tab, including the tabs inherited from the input workbook. The task Bosch (Claude Code, task 3, attempt 1252) illustrates this: every tab has a print area, and in the task Nike (Claude for Excel, task 93, attempt 1662), the top five rows of the long calculation sheets are frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结窗格与打印区域（Claude Code、Claude for Excel）。 模型会将长工作表的表头冻结在合理的位置，而不会冻结过多内容，Claude Code 还会为每个工作表标签定义打印区域，包括从输入工作簿继承的标签。 Bosch 任务（Claude Code，任务 3，尝试 1252）说明了这一点：每个标签都有打印区域；而在 Nike 任务（Claude for Excel，任务 93，尝试 1662）中，长计算工作表的前五行被冻结。

paragraphs.en: Compact engines (Claude for Excel). The model solves a problem with one parameterized engine instead of copying logic: native iterative calculation, or one shared FCFF build. For example, in the task RelativeDevelopment (Claude for Excel, task 48, attempt 1556), native iteration replaces the 30 and 41 copied rows in which Claude Code and Claude Cowork unroll the WACC calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 紧凑引擎（Claude for Excel）。 该模型用一个参数化引擎来解决问题，而不是复制逻辑：原生迭代计算，或共享的 FCFF 构建。 例如，在任务 RelativeDevelopment（Claude for Excel，任务 48，尝试 1556）中，原生迭代取代了 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 展开 WACC 计算时复制的 30 行和 41 行。

paragraphs.en: Oversized text columns and rows (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model puts long texts, such as the cover, table of contents, checks, and change log, into extremely wide single columns or very tall wrapped rows; Claude Code, at the same time, often leaves some numeric and timeline columns too narrow, so they display ###. This is evident in the task PercentageDevelopment (Claude Cowork, task 96, attempt 1633), where the cover column is 150 characters wide, the purpose column of the table of contents 120 characters, and the check-label column 92 characters, and in the task DebtDeclineDynamics (Claude Code, task 14, attempt 1935), where the text columns are 120 to 130 characters wide, while the loan amount on the schedule sheet displays as ###.
paragraphs.zh: 过宽的文本列和行（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。 模型会把长文本，例如封面、目录、检查项和变更日志，放进极宽的单列或很高的自动换行行中；与此同时，Claude Code 常常把某些数值和时间线列设置得过窄，导致它们显示为 ###。 这在任务 PercentageDevelopment（Claude Cowork，任务 96，尝试 1633）中很明显，其中封面列宽为 150 个字符、目录的用途列为 120 个字符、检查项标签列为 92 个字符；在任务 DebtDeclineDynamics（Claude Code，任务 14，尝试 1935）中也很明显，其中文本列宽为 120 到 130 个字符，而计划表中的贷款金额却显示为 ###。

paragraphs.en: “Rounded to” notes for display formats (all three harnesses). The model labels sheets as “rounded to $0.01” although the formulas carry full precision and only the number formats limit what is shown; the figures are displayed to, not rounded to, that precision. In the task CorpBond (Claude Cowork, task 10, attempt 1298), “rounded to $0.01” labels sit above thousands of schedule formulas that use no rounding function, and in the task BreakingDowntheBalance (Claude for Excel, task 4, attempt 1269), none of the 12,483 schedule formulas under such a label rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 展示格式的「保留至」标注（全部三个测试框架）。 模型将工作表标注为「保留至 $0.01」，尽管公式本身携带完整精度，只是数字格式限制了显示内容；这些数字是显示到该精度，而非舍入到该精度。 在任务 CorpBond（Claude Cowork，任务 10，第 1298 次尝试）中，「保留至 $0.01」的标注下方有数千个未使用任何舍入函数的日程表公式；而在任务 BreakingDowntheBalance（Claude for Excel，任务 4，第 1269 次尝试）中，该标注下的 12,483 个日程表公式没有一个进行舍入。

paragraphs.en: Copied engines and nested formulas (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model tends toward brute force: it copies entire engines instead of creating a single parameterized engine or using a data table; furthermore, Claude Cowork writes monolithic formulas, even though helper rows would make the financial model easier to review. In the task CashNiagara (Claude Code, task 7, attempt 1874), for instance, the entire 277 × 86 277\times 86 waterfall is copied three times, and in the Easy-level task MeridianOutdoor (Claude Cowork, task 88, attempt 1620), the commentary text formulas repeat nested IFERROR, TEXT, ABS, and IF calls.
paragraphs.zh: 复制整个引擎和嵌套公式（Claude Code、Claude Cowork）。 该模型倾向于暴力求解：它会复制整个引擎，而不是创建一个带参数的单一引擎或使用数据表；此外，Claude Cowork 会编写庞大的整块公式，尽管使用辅助行会让财务模型更易于审查。 例如，在任务 CashNiagara（Claude Code，任务 7，尝试 1874）中，整个 277 × 86 277\times 86 的瀑布结构被复制了三次；在 Easy 级别任务 MeridianOutdoor（Claude Cowork，任务 88，尝试 1620）中，评论文本的公式重复使用了嵌套的 IFERROR、TEXT、ABS 和 IF 调用。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-width timelines (Claude Code, Claude Cowork). The model sometimes creates the timeline with a fixed number of columns or references fixed ranges, so extending the time period or changing the start date requires manually copying columns and editing ranges. For example, in the task DetailedLoan (Claude Code, task 16, attempt 1893), the timeline is fixed at 1,008 columns, and the cover instructs users to copy the last column to the right for a longer horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 固定宽度的时间线（Claude Code，Claude Cowork）。 模型有时会创建具有固定列数的时间线，或引用固定的范围，因此要延长时间段或更改开始日期，就需要手动复制列并编辑范围。 例如，在任务 DetailedLoan（Claude Code，任务 16，尝试 1893）中，时间线固定为 1,008 列，封面说明指导用户将最后一列向右复制以获得更长的时间跨度。

paragraphs.en: Negatives with minus signs (Claude Code). The model often displays negative numbers with a leading minus sign instead of in parentheses, even for final answers and summary outputs. This is evident in the task Harrington (Claude Code, task 31, attempt 1949), where answers are displayed as −2,820.0000 and −7.62%.
paragraphs.zh: 带负号的负数（Claude Code）。 该模型经常在负数前使用负号而不是括号来显示，即使是在最终答案和汇总输出中也是如此。 这在任务 Harrington（Claude Code，任务 31，尝试 1949）中很明显，其中答案显示为 −2,820.0000 和 −7.62%。

paragraphs.en: Unexplained formulas and unguarded circular loops (Claude for Excel). Non-obvious formulas, such as array MEDIAN(IF()), MMULT, and SUMPRODUCT/INDEX/MATCH blocks, carry no cell note or adjacent explanation, and some circular models switch on iterative calculation without a breaker switch, a stated reason for the circularity, or a note on how the loop resolves. The task ProductionPlanning (Claude for Excel, task 44, attempt 1544) illustrates this: the SUMPRODUCT/INDEX/MATCH and MMULT blocks carry no explanatory note, and in the task PlasticParts (Claude for Excel, task 43, attempt 1541), the circular financing and cash block has no breaker, justification, or note.

paragraphs.en: Misused font colors (Claude for Excel). The reserved blue input and green link fonts appear in cells that are neither input fields nor links, such as text in change logs, fixed labels, legends, and even entire blocks of same-sheet calculations. This is evident in the task FruitJuice (Claude for Excel, task 28, attempt 1496), where same-sheet calculations are in the green reserved for cross-sheet links, and in the task FundFun (Claude for Excel, task 29, attempt 1502), where the entire change log is in input blue.
paragraphs.zh: 字体颜色使用不当（Claude for Excel）。 保留的蓝色输入字体和绿色链接字体出现在既非输入字段也非链接的单元格中，例如变更日志中的文本、固定标签、图例，甚至整块同表计算。 这在任务 FruitJuice（Claude for Excel，任务 28，尝试 1496）中很明显，其中同表计算使用了为跨表链接保留的绿色；在任务 FundFun（Claude for Excel，任务 29，尝试 1502）中也很明显，其中整个变更日志使用了输入蓝色。

paragraphs.en: Most of these points stand out in both Claude Code and Claude Cowork and therefore belong to the model, including the “rounded to” notes; Claude Code merely documents rounding correctly more often and sets print areas more consistently. The Excel add-in changes the picture: compared with the other two harnesses, the model builds leaner engines but explains fewer formulas and misuses font colors more often. Since Opus 5 shows the same shift toward lean but sparsely documented engines in Claude for Excel, and all agents in the Excel harness blur the color code, these differences appear to stem largely from the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题点大多在 Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork 中都同样突出，因此应归属于模型本身，包括“四舍五入到”的备注；只是 Claude Code 更经常正确地记录舍入方式，并更一致地设置打印区域。 Excel 插件改变了这一图景：与其他两个测试框架相比，模型构建的引擎更精简，但解释的公式更少，且更常误用字体颜色。 由于 Opus 5 在 Claude for Excel 中也表现出向精简但文档稀少的引擎的同样转变，而且 Excel 测试框架中的所有智能体都混淆了颜色代码，这些差异似乎主要源于测试框架本身。

paragraphs.en: Opus 5 in Claude Cowork is a strong builder whose strengths are sense checks against outside benchmarks, named global drivers, and accurate rounding notes. In Claude for Excel, its engines are unusually lean, but it leaves the finishing layer undone. In both harnesses, its check flags are less reliable and its cell formatting is worse than those of the other leading models.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Cowork 中的 Opus 5 是一个很强的构建者，其优势在于对照外部基准进行合理性检查、命名全局驱动因素，以及准确的舍入说明。 在 Claude for Excel 中，它的引擎异常精简，但没有完成收尾层的工作。 在这两个测试框架中，它的检查标记可靠性较低，其单元格格式处理也比其他领先模型更差。

paragraphs.en: Accurate rounding notes (both harnesses). The notes state that figures are “shown to” a given precision while full precision is carried, and they name the questions tab as the only place where ROUND is applied. In the task CashNiagara (Claude Cowork, task 7, attempt 3260), the precision notes on the summary and annual cash-flow sheets read “shown to” and state that full precision is retained, and in the task Telecom (Claude for Excel, task 59, attempt 2343), a note separates display precision from the ROUND applied on the questions tab.
paragraphs.zh: 准确的舍入说明（两个测试框架均适用）。 这些说明指出数字“显示为”某一精度，同时保留了完整精度，并指明问题标签页是唯一应用 ROUND 的地方。 在任务 CashNiagara（Claude Cowork，任务 7，尝试 3260）中，汇总表和年度现金流表上的精度说明写的是“显示为”，并声明保留了完整精度；在任务 Telecom（Claude for Excel，任务 59，尝试 2343）中，一条说明将显示精度与问题标签页上应用的 ROUND 区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Sense checks and named drivers (Claude Cowork). The check sheets often include a block that tests headline outputs against dated outside benchmarks or judgment ranges, and key global inputs, such as anchor dates, horizon length, case selector, and core rates, routinely get clear defined names. For example, in the task TheInterestGame (Claude Cowork, task 60, attempt 3650), the installment, effective annual rate, interest burden, debt service, and yield are tested against outside benchmark ranges, and in the task TBondII (Claude Cowork, task 56, attempt 3635), ten global drivers are named.
paragraphs.zh: 直觉校验与命名驱动变量（Claude Cowork）。 这些核对表通常包含一个模块，用于将关键输出与带有日期的外部基准或判断区间进行对照测试，而关键的全局输入，例如锚定日期、期限长度、情景选择器和核心利率，通常会获得明确定义的名称。 例如，在任务 TheInterestGame（Claude Cowork，任务 60，第 3650 次尝试）中，分期还款额、实际年利率、利息负担、偿债支出和收益率均与外部基准区间进行了对照测试；在任务 TBondII（Claude Cowork，任务 56，第 3635 次尝试）中，则有十个全局驱动变量被明确命名。

paragraphs.en: Insert-safe totals and an anchored horizon (Claude Cowork). Subtotal ranges include labeled buffer rows or columns, so that line items can be inserted without breaking the sums, and timelines are usually prebuilt across the required horizon and driven by one anchor date and a length driver. In the task DailyDetail (Claude Cowork, task 77, attempt 3673), for instance, open buffer rows precede the totals, and in the task CashConversionLab (Claude Cowork, task 6, attempt 3235), the 60-quarter horizon runs from one anchor.
paragraphs.zh: 可安全插入的小计与锚定的时间跨度（Claude Cowork）。 小计范围包含已标记的缓冲行或缓冲列，因此可以插入明细项而不破坏求和结果，并且时间轴通常已按所需时间跨度预先构建，由一个锚定日期和一个长度驱动参数控制。 例如，在任务 DailyDetail（Claude Cowork，任务 77，尝试 3673）中，开放的缓冲行位于总计之前；而在任务 CashConversionLab（Claude Cowork，任务 6，尝试 3235）中，60 个季度的时间跨度由一个锚定点开始运行。

paragraphs.en: Compact engines and freeze panes (Claude for Excel). Where other agents copy the same logic across dozens of case sheets or huge iteration grids, the model usually builds one compact engine and points everything else at it; it also freezes the header rows and label columns of long calculation and valuation sheets without freezing too much. This is evident in the task FundRebalancing (Claude for Excel, task 85, attempt 2452), where one parameterized engine does the work, and in the task ApfelInc (Claude for Excel, task 1, attempt 2001), where the long tabs are frozen at sensible positions.
paragraphs.zh: 紧凑的引擎和冻结窗格（Claude for Excel）。 当其他智能体在数十个工作表案例或庞大的迭代网格中复制相同逻辑时，该模型通常会构建一个紧凑的引擎，并让其他所有内容都指向它；它还会冻结长计算表和估值表的表头行和标签列，而不会冻结过多内容。 这在任务 FundRebalancing（Claude for Excel，任务 85，尝试 2452）中显而易见，其中一个参数化引擎完成了全部工作；在任务 ApfelInc（Claude for Excel，任务 1，尝试 2001）中也可见，其中较长的工作表在合理的位置被冻结。

paragraphs.en: Check flags that cannot be trusted (both harnesses). Claude Cowork’s check formulas often perform arithmetic on whole ranges or nest a multi-cell IF or ABS inside SUMPRODUCT or MAX without array entry; they return #VALUE! and pass the error into the status cells meant to flag problems. Claude for Excel’s master error flag is often plain text or fixed green without conditional formatting, so it cannot turn red when a check fails. For example, 18 check formulas return #VALUE! in the task Fixings (Claude Cowork, task 23, attempt 3472), and the summary of the task LiquiditySplatter (Claude for Excel, task 33, attempt 2133) reads “ALL CHECKS PASS” while the debt waterfall contains #NAME? errors.
paragraphs.zh: 检查那些无法信任的标记（两个测试框架皆然）。 Claude Cowork 的检查公式经常对整段区域做算术运算，或把多单元格的 IF 或 ABS 嵌入 SUMPRODUCT 或 MAX 而未按数组公式输入；它们会返回 #VALUE!，并把错误传递给本应用于标记问题的状态单元格。 Claude for Excel 的总错误标记通常是纯文本或固定的绿色且没有条件格式，因此当检查失败时它无法变红。 例如，在任务 Fixings（Claude Cowork，任务 23，尝试 3472）中有 18 个检查公式返回 #VALUE!，而在任务 LiquiditySplatter（Claude for Excel，任务 33，尝试 2133）的摘要写着"ALL CHECKS PASS"的同时，债务瀑布中却包含 #NAME? 错误。

paragraphs.en: Loose cell formatting (both harnesses). Cross-sheet formulas appear in black despite the workbook’s own green-link legend or switch between green and black; in Claude Cowork, numbers are often centered and titles merged. For example, in the task FlightPlan (Claude Cowork, task 24, attempt 3375), each shortest-path sheet uses eight merged title ranges instead of Center Across Selection, and in the task GermanLife (Claude for Excel, task 30, attempt 2092), cross-sheet formulas are black on one sheet but green on the summary and tax sheets.
paragraphs.zh: 单元格格式松散（两个测试环境均是如此）。 跨表公式显示为黑色，与本工作簿自带的绿色链接图例不符，或在绿色与黑色之间切换；在 Claude Cowork 中，数字常常居中显示，标题则被合并。 例如，在任务 FlightPlan（Claude Cowork，任务 24，尝试 3375）中，每个最短路径表使用八个合并的标题区域，而非跨列居中；在任务 GermanLife（Claude for Excel，任务 30，尝试 2092）中，跨表公式在一个表中显示为黑色，但在汇总表和税务表中显示为绿色。

sents.zh: 单元格格式松散（两个测试环境均是如此）。

paragraphs.en: Columns too narrow (Claude Cowork). Number and date columns are sometimes narrower than their content, so summary results, reconciliation values, or an entire date column display as ###, more often than for any other agent. A case in point is the task Bosch (Claude Cowork, task 3, attempt 3290), where a column that is too narrow makes four summary outputs display as ###.

paragraphs.en: Unfinished navigation, print setup, and formula notes (Claude for Excel). The table of contents on the summary sheet is plain text without hyperlinks, print areas are often undefined, and non-obvious logic, such as nested revolver waterfalls, array reconciliations, and nested lookups, often carries no explanation. In the task QuarterlyRatios (Claude for Excel, task 47, attempt 2258), all eight sheets are listed, but none is linked; in the task CoastalAggregates (Claude for Excel, task 8, attempt 2020), no sheet has a print area; and in the task DebtFlow (Claude for Excel, task 15, attempt 2038), the revolver draw-and-repay and vesting-offset formulas are left unexplained.

paragraphs.en: The accurate rounding notes, the unreliable check flags, and the loose formatting stand out in both harnesses and belong to the model; that Fable 5.1 mislabels rounding in the same two harnesses underlines this. Several differences are observed to follow the harness: the sense checks, named drivers, and buffer rows that stand out in Claude Cowork are rare in the Excel add-ins, including Opus 5 in Claude for Excel; its anchored timelines are also rare in Claude for Excel, although GPT-5.6 Sol builds such timelines in ChatGPT for Excel; and its formula notes thin out there, as they do for Fable 5.1; its compact engines in Claude for Excel likewise mirror those of Fable 5.1 in that harness.
paragraphs.zh: 准确的舍入批注、不可靠的核对标志以及松散的格式在两个测试框架中都很显眼，且应归因于模型；Fable 5.1 在同样两个测试框架中对舍入的错误标注进一步印证了这一点。 观察到若干差异是随测试框架而定的：在 Claude Cowork 中显眼的语义检查、命名驱动因素和缓冲行，在 Excel 加载项中很少见，包括在 Claude for Excel 中的 Opus 5；其锚定时间线在 Claude for Excel 中同样少见，尽管 GPT-5.6 Sol 会在 ChatGPT for Excel 中构建此类时间线；其公式批注在该环境中减少，Fable 5.1 也是如此；其在 Claude for Excel 中的精简引擎同样与 Fable 5.1 在该测试框架中的表现相似。

paragraphs.en: In both harnesses, GPT-6 Astra builds polished, print-ready, well-documented workbooks with a working master error flag, but it never names its key inputs, places its own blocks below inherited “End Sheet” markers, and tests its outputs only against the workbook itself.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个测试框架中，GPT-6 Astra 都能构建出精美、可直接打印、文档完善的电子表格，并带有可正常工作的主错误标记，但它从不命名其关键输入，将自己的区块放在继承的"End Sheet"标记之下，并且只针对电子表格本身测试其输出。

paragraphs.en: Print-ready page setup (both harnesses). The model defines print areas on every tab and places manual page breaks at section or table boundaries on multi-page sheets. The task LogisticsCategorization (ChatGPT Work, task 34, attempt 1335) illustrates this: every multi-page sheet has manual page breaks, and so do the long sheets in the task 8Options (Codex, task 69, attempt 1748).
paragraphs.zh: 适合打印的页面设置（两个 harness 均适用）。 模型在每个工作表标签上都定义了打印区域，并在多页工作表的分节或表格边界处插入手动分页符。 任务 LogisticsCategorization（ChatGPT Work，任务 34，尝试 1335）说明了这一点：每个多页工作表都有手动分页符，任务 8Options（Codex，任务 69，尝试 1748）中的长工作表也是如此。

paragraphs.en: Workbooks with source citations, notes, and a linked table of contents (both harnesses). Inputs cite their source sheet or cell, the model’s own judgment calls carry an owner and a date, non-obvious formula blocks, such as WACC iteration, interpolation, asset vintages, and tax timing, carry cell notes or nearby methodology notes, and the table of contents holds working hyperlinks to every sheet. For example, in the task FiveAutomotive (ChatGPT Work, task 22, attempt 1413), block notes and cell comments explain the WACC iteration, interpolation, debt, and asset-vintage blocks, and in the task TwoNOne (Codex, task 101, attempt 1736), notes cover debt timing, the 30/360 convention, tax, the waterfall, and the terminal value, and the contents tab links to every sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 带有来源引用、注释和带链接目录的工作簿（两种测试框架均适用）。 输入引用其来源工作表或单元格，模型自身的判断带有负责人和日期，非显而易见的公式块（如 WACC 迭代、插值、资产年份批次和税务时点）带有单元格注释或就近的方法论注释，且目录中包含指向每个工作表的可用超链接。 例如，在任务 FiveAutomotive（ChatGPT Work，任务 22，尝试 1413）中，块注释和单元格批注解释了 WACC 迭代、插值、债务和资产年份批次等块；在任务 TwoNOne（Codex，任务 101，尝试 1736）中，注释涵盖了债务时点、30/360 计息惯例、税务、瀑布式分配和终值，且目录标签页链接到每一个工作表。

paragraphs.en: Master error flag wired to the checks (both harnesses). Every workbook gets a master error flag on the summary sheet that is linked to the roll-up of the check sheet and conditionally formatted to turn red on failure. This is evident in the task TwoNOne (ChatGPT Work, task 101, attempt 1545), where the flag is tied to the count of failed checks, and in the task CashConversionLab (Codex, task 6, attempt 1842), where the formula-linked flag turns red on failure.
paragraphs.zh: 将主错误标志接入检查项（两个测试框架均是如此）。 每个工作簿都在汇总表上有一个主错误标志，该标志链接到检查表的汇总结果，并设置了条件格式，在失败时变红。 这在任务 TwoNOne（ChatGPT Work，任务 101，尝试 1545）中显而易见，该标志与失败检查的数量挂钩；在任务 CashConversionLab（Codex，任务 6，尝试 1842）中也可见，公式链接的标志在失败时变红。

paragraphs.en: Formulas that hold up under stress (ChatGPT Work). The formulas usually guard the edge cases, such as zero rates, schedule capacity, whole payment counts, selector validity, and zero-machine or negative-cash states, so plausible input changes rarely produce #DIV/0!, #N/A, or impossible balances. In the task LargeBalance (ChatGPT Work, task 87, attempt 1593), no break was found when the duration and working-capital drivers were stressed.
paragraphs.zh: 经得起压力测试的公式（ChatGPT Work）。 这些公式通常会防范边界情况，例如零利率、日程容量、整笔付款次数、选择器有效性，以及零机器或负现金状态，因此合理的输入变动很少会产生 #DIV/0!、#N/A 或不可能的余额。 在任务 LargeBalance（ChatGPT Work，任务 87，尝试 1593）中，对工期和营运资金驱动因素进行压力测试时未发现任何故障。

paragraphs.en: Enforced validation and one house style (Codex). The model puts validation with active error alerts and sensible bounds on key dates, rates, counts, and selectors, and it gives all built sheets one font and one title, header, and total style, with blue inputs, black formulas, green cross-sheet links, and negatives in parentheses. In the task ApfelInc (Codex, task 1, attempt 1831), for instance, the key editable drivers carry validation with active alerts, and in the task NextEraEnergy (Codex, task 39, attempt 1719), the font colors follow the convention on every built sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 强制校验和统一的表格风格（Codex）。 模型在校验上启用了主动错误提示，并对关键日期、比率、计数和选择器设置了合理的界限，同时让所有构建的表格使用同一字体和统一的标题、表头与总计样式，蓝色为输入、黑色为公式、绿色为跨表链接、负数用括号表示。 例如，在任务 ApfelInc（Codex，任务 1，尝试 1831）中，关键的可编辑驱动变量都带有启用主动提示的校验；在任务 NextEraEnergy（Codex，任务 39，尝试 1719）中，字体颜色在每张构建的表格上都遵循了上述约定。

paragraphs.en: Timelines that roll from one input (Codex). The model prebuilds the full required horizon from a central anchor date and period controls, so dates and periods roll forward without edits to the formulas. A case in point is the task OnlyOperational (Codex, task 94, attempt 1826), where all dates of the 14-year timeline follow the central drivers, with no need for manual extensions to change the horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 时间线可从单一输入（Codex）滚动延伸。 模型会根据中央锚定日期与期间控制项预构建所需的完整时间跨度，因此日期与期间可自动向前滚动，无需修改公式。 一个典型例子是 OnlyOperational 任务（Codex，任务 94，尝试 1826），其中 14 年时间线的所有日期均遵循中央驱动因素，无需手动扩展即可更改时间跨度。

paragraphs.en: No named ranges (both harnesses). The model never defines names, so global drivers, such as anchor dates, horizons, tax rates, WACC, and case selectors, are referenced only by cell address. ChatGPT Work also adds data validation to key inputs but switches the error alerts off, so invalid entries pass without warning. For example, in the task ThreeCars (task 65), both ChatGPT Work (attempt 1406) and Codex (attempt 1755) reference the valuation date, the tax rate, and WACC only by cell address.
paragraphs.zh: 没有命名区域（两个测试框架均如此）。 模型从不定义名称，因此锚定日期、预测期、税率、WACC 和情形选择器等全局驱动参数仅通过单元格地址引用。 ChatGPT Work 还会为关键输入添加数据验证，但关闭了错误警报，因此无效输入会毫无警告地通过。 例如，在任务 ThreeCars（任务 65）中，ChatGPT Work（尝试 1406）和 Codex（尝试 1755）均仅通过单元格地址引用估值日期、税率和 WACC。

sents.zh: 没有命名区域（两个测试框架均如此）。

sents.en: The model never defines names, so global drivers, such as anchor dates, horizons, tax rates, WACC, and case selectors, are referenced only by cell address.
sents.zh: 模型从不定义名称，因此锚定日期、预测期、税率、WACC 和情形选择器等全局驱动参数仅通过单元格地址引用。

sents.en: ChatGPT Work also adds data validation to key inputs but switches the error alerts off, so invalid entries pass without warning.
sents.zh: ChatGPT Work 还会为关键输入添加数据验证，但关闭了错误警报，因此无效输入会毫无警告地通过。

sents.en: For example, in the task ThreeCars (task 65), both ChatGPT Work (attempt 1406) and Codex (attempt 1755) reference the valuation date, the tax rate, and WACC only by cell address.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 ThreeCars（任务 65）中，ChatGPT Work（尝试 1406）和 Codex（尝试 1755）均仅通过单元格地址引用估值日期、税率和 WACC。

paragraphs.en: Content below “End Sheet” markers (both harnesses). The model appends its own controls, inputs, derived drivers, and notes below the “End Sheet” marker of the inherited assumptions sheet, so live inputs sit outside the sheet’s declared structure; ChatGPT Work also stacks second timelines or date-helper series onto sheets that already have a main timeline. The task DoctorvsTrade (task 18) illustrates this: ChatGPT Work (attempt 1403) continues live inputs and interpretation notes past the marker, and Codex (attempt 1845) adds 42 rows of controls and derived timing after it.
paragraphs.zh: 「End Sheet」标记下方的内容（两个 harness 均如此）。 模型会在继承假设表的「End Sheet」标记下方追加其自己的控件、输入、派生驱动因素和备注，因此实时输入位于该表已声明结构之外；ChatGPT Work 还会在已有主时间线的表上再叠加第二条时间线或日期辅助序列。 任务 DoctorvsTrade（任务 18）说明了这一点：ChatGPT Work（尝试 1403）在标记之后继续写实时输入和解读备注，而 Codex（尝试 1845）在其后添加了 42 行控件和派生时间安排。

paragraphs.en: Sense checks that never look outside (both harnesses). The model builds sense-check blocks, but these compare the outputs only with figures from the same workbook or with generic arithmetic bounds and often state outright that there is no external benchmark. This is evident in the task QuarterlyRatios (ChatGPT Work, task 47, attempt 1468), where only internal break-even checks are run, next to a note that there are no external benchmarks, and in the task EasyRev (ChatGPT Work, task 81, attempt 1565), where the “same-sample benchmark” is another forecast built from the same inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 从不查看外部的合理性检查（两个测试框架均是如此）。 模型会构建合理性检查模块，但这些检查只是将输出与同一工作簿中的数字或通用算术边界进行比较，并且常常直接声明没有外部基准。 这在任务 QuarterlyRatios（ChatGPT Work，任务 47，尝试 1468）中很明显，其中只运行了内部盈亏平衡检查，并附注说明没有外部基准；在任务 EasyRev（ChatGPT Work，任务 81，尝试 1565）中也很明显，其中「同样本基准」是基于相同输入构建的另一个预测。

paragraphs.en: “Rounded to” labels for display formats (ChatGPT Work). Headers and notes often state that values are “rounded to 0.01” or “to 0.1%”, while the formulas keep full precision and only the displayed precision is as stated. In the task CFQuarterly (ChatGPT Work, task 74, attempt 1425), for instance, a “rounded to $0.01mm” label sits above thousands of formulas without ROUND.
paragraphs.zh: 显示格式的“四舍五入至”标签（ChatGPT Work）。 表头和注释中常注明数值“四舍五入至 0.01”或“精确到 0.1%”，而公式仍保留完整精度，仅显示的精度如所述。 例如，在任务 CFQuarterly（ChatGPT Work，任务 74，第 1425 次尝试）中，一个“四舍五入至 $0.01mm”的标签位于数千个未使用 ROUND 的公式之上。

paragraphs.en: Oversized, formula-heavy files (Codex). The model prefills huge capacity grids with thousands of inactive formula rows or columns and adds duplicate copies of source data, so even small models end up relatively large and carry a heavy recalculation load. In the task LeaseorKeys (Codex, task 32, attempt 1817), about 122,000 formulas are copied across 1,200 columns, and the checks contain very large ISERROR arrays.
paragraphs.zh: 过大且公式繁多的文件（Codex）。 模型会预填充包含数千行或列非活动公式的巨大容量网格，并添加源数据的重复副本，因此即使是很小的模型最终也会变得相对庞大，并承受沉重的重新计算负担。 在任务 LeaseorKeys（Codex，任务 32，尝试 1817）中，大约 122,000 个公式被复制到 1,200 列中，并且检查中包含非常大的 ISERROR 数组。

paragraphs.en: The page setup, documentation, and master error flag, as well as the missing names, the blocks below “End Sheet” markers, and the inward-looking sense checks, stand out in both harnesses and belong to the model; ChatGPT Pro, running GPT-6, shows most of them as well. Where the two harnesses are observed to differ, the difference concerns how strictly the model applies conventions: in Codex, it keeps validation alerts on, describes rounding correctly, and prebuilds its timelines from one anchor, whereas in ChatGPT Work, it switches the alerts off, labels formatted figures as rounded, and sometimes fixes the length of its timelines. In Codex, the prebuilt timelines come at the price of oversized files. The robust formulas of ChatGPT Work and the house style of Codex, by contrast, stand out in one harness only.
paragraphs.zh: 页面设置、文档说明和主错误标志，以及缺失的名称、“End Sheet”标记下方的区块和向内的自查，在两个测试环境中都很突出，属于模型层面；运行 GPT-6 的 ChatGPT Pro 也显示出其中大部分特征。 当观察到两个测试环境存在差异时，差异在于模型应用规范的严格程度：在 Codex 中，它保持验证提醒开启，正确描述舍入方式，并从单一锚点预构建时间线；而在 ChatGPT Work 中，它会关闭提醒，把格式化后的数字标注为已舍入，有时还会固定时间线的长度。 在 Codex 中，预构建的时间线以文件过大为代价。 相比之下，ChatGPT Work 的稳健公式和 Codex 的内部风格只在其中一个测试环境中突出。

paragraphs.en: GPT-6 in ChatGPT Pro is a disciplined, convention-heavy builder that leads the field on flexible timelines, honest rounding statements, and a uniform house font, but it overbuilds its workbooks with brute-force grids and duplicated engines, skips freeze panes, and rarely tests its outputs against outside benchmarks. Its page breaks, blocks below “End Sheet” markers, and inward-looking sense checks also mark GPT-6 Astra in both of its harnesses, which points to the model family rather than the harness.
paragraphs.zh: ChatGPT Pro 中的 GPT-6 是一位守规矩、高度依赖惯例的构建者，在灵活的时间线、如实的舍入说明和统一的自家字体方面领跑业界，但它用蛮力网格和重复的引擎过度构建工作簿，跳过冻结窗格，也很少将输出与外部基准进行对照测试。 分页符、「End Sheet」标记下方的区块，以及向内的自我核查，也出现在两种测试框架下的 GPT-6 Astra 身上，这说明问题出在模型家族而非测试框架。

paragraphs.en: Flexible timelines. The model builds the full required horizon up front and drives it from one central anchor date and period inputs, so that changing the forecast length within that horizon requires no manual column copying or range edits. For example, in the task OnlyOperational (task 94, attempt 2644), the 2030–2043 timeline follows the central date and period controls, and in the task SingleForever (task 53, attempt 2428), the formula-driven timeline responds to the horizon inputs without edits.
paragraphs.zh: 灵活的时间线。 该模型预先构建完整所需的时间跨度，并由一个中央锚定日期和期间输入驱动，因此在时间跨度内更改预测长度无需手动复制列或编辑区域。 例如，在任务 OnlyOperational（任务 94，尝试 2644）中，2030–2043 年的时间线遵循中央日期和期间控制；在任务 SingleForever（任务 53，尝试 2428）中，由公式驱动的时间线无需编辑即可响应时间跨度输入。

paragraphs.en: Visible master error flag. The model almost always rolls every check up into one master pass/fail cell on the summary, linked to the check sheet and conditionally formatted to turn red on failure. A case in point is the task CashConversionLab (task 6, attempt 2019), where the master flag is conditionally formatted.
paragraphs.zh: 可见的主错误标志。 该模型几乎总是将所有检查汇总为摘要上的一个主通过/失败单元格，该单元格链接到检查表并设置了条件格式，在失败时变红。 一个典型例子是任务 CashConversionLab（任务 6，尝试 2019），其中主标志使用了条件格式。

paragraphs.en: Honest rounding statements. The model keeps display precision separate from actual rounding: calculation sheets are labeled “shown to $0.01” and keep full-precision formulas, and only the final answer block applies ROUND. The task NestQuest (task 38, attempt 2333) illustrates this: full-precision calculations, the “shown to $0.01” display, and the explicitly rounded answers are kept distinct.
paragraphs.zh: 诚实的舍入表述。 模型将显示精度与实际舍入分开处理：计算表标注为「按 $0.01 显示」并保留全精度公式，只有最终答案块应用 ROUND。 任务 NestQuest（任务 38，尝试 2333）说明了这一点：全精度计算、「按 $0.01 显示」的展示以及明确舍入后的答案是相互分开的。

paragraphs.en: Uniform, print-ready sheets. The model restyles every sheet it builds to a single font, Arial 10, with matching section bands, headers, and total styles, and it places manual page breaks at section or period boundaries on sheets that print to several pages. In the task ConstantFlow (task 9, attempt 2036), for instance, all built sheets use Arial 10 throughout, and in the task TheInterestGame (task 60, attempt 2505), the multi-page sheets carry manual page breaks.
paragraphs.zh: 统一、可直接打印的工作表。 模型将其构建的每个工作表都重新排版为统一字体 Arial 10，并采用一致的分区条带、表头与合计样式，同时在打印为多页的工作表上，于分区或期间边界处插入手动分页符。 例如，在任务 ConstantFlow（任务 9，第 2036 次尝试）中，所有构建的工作表均全程使用 Arial 10，而在任务 TheInterestGame（任务 60，第 2505 次尝试）中，多页工作表带有手动分页符。

paragraphs.en: Sourced assumptions and annotated formulas. The model adds a source column that cites the input workbook for each input, tags its own judgment calls with an owner and a date, and places methodology notes beside non-obvious blocks, such as WACC iteration, depreciation vintages, and cash-tax timing. This is evident in the task FruitJuice (task 28, attempt 2237), where every input on the assumptions sheet carries a citation, and every judgment an owner and a date.
paragraphs.zh: 来源可查的假设与带批注的公式。 该模型会增加一个来源列，为每个输入引用其所在的工作簿，并用自己的所有者和日期标记其判断决策，同时将方法论说明放在不明显的模块旁边，例如 WACC（加权平均资本成本）迭代、折旧批次和现金税时点。 这在任务 FruitJuice（任务 28，尝试 2237）中体现得很明显：假设表上的每个输入都带有引用，每个判断都标有所有者和日期。

paragraphs.en: Overbuilt, bloated workbooks. The model tends toward brute force: for small cases, it creates reserve calculation grids with more than a thousand rows, duplicates entire calculation modules instead of parameterizing a single one, expands logic into replicated matrices, and adds duplicate register and appendix blocks, resulting in inefficient workbooks that are difficult to review and modify. For example, in the task CorpBond (task 10, attempt 2046), tens of thousands of reserve-grid formulas serve a case with 40 payments, and in the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2039), the entire waterfall engine is duplicated (17,521 formulas) where one selector-driven engine would be sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 过度构建、臃肿的工作簿。 该模型倾向于使用暴力方法：对于小规模案例，它会创建超过一千行的准备金计算网格，复制整个计算模块而不是将单个模块参数化，将逻辑扩展为重复的矩阵，并添加重复的登记表和附录模块，导致工作簿效率低下、难以审阅和修改。 例如，在任务 CorpBond（任务 10，尝试 2046）中，数以万计的准备金网格公式却服务于一个仅有 40 笔付款的案例；而在任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，尝试 2039）中，整个瀑布流引擎被完整复制（17,521 个公式），而实际上一个由选择器驱动的引擎就足够了。

paragraphs.en: No sense checks against outside benchmarks. The model’s sense-check sections contain only internal reconciliations, comparisons with the workbook’s own historical figures, or trivial bounds. In the task EasyRev (task 81, attempt 2610), the error metrics MAE and MAPE are checked only against another forecast built in the same workbook.
paragraphs.zh: 没有对照外部基准进行合理性检验。 模型的合理性检验部分仅包含内部核对、与工作簿自身历史数据的比较，或一些无关紧要的界限检查。 在任务 EasyRev（任务 81，尝试 2610）中，误差指标 MAE 和 MAPE 仅与同一工作簿中构建的另一个预测进行了对比检验。

paragraphs.en: Missing freeze panes. Very wide monthly schedules and long check and summary sheets usually ship without freeze panes, so row labels and period headers scroll out of view; when the model does freeze panes, it sometimes locks an excessive block of rows. This is evident in the task PastaInc (task 41, attempt 2406), where the integrated statements span 149 columns with no frozen labels or headers, and in the task CashConversionLab (task 6, attempt 2019), where the frozen rows take up most of a regular screen view, leaving little room to see the actual financial model.
paragraphs.zh: 缺少冻结窗格。 非常宽的月度进度表以及冗长的核对表和汇总表通常没有冻结窗格，导致行标签和期间表头滚动出视野；当模型确实设置了冻结窗格时，有时会锁定过多的行块。 这在任务 PastaInc（任务 41，尝试 2406）中很明显，其合并报表横跨 149 列却没有冻结标签或表头；在任务 CashConversionLab（任务 6，尝试 2019）中，冻结行占据了常规屏幕视图的大部分，几乎没有留下查看实际财务模型的空间。

paragraphs.en: Content below “End Sheet” markers. When extending an inherited assumptions sheet, the model keeps its “End Sheet” marker and appends new controls, drivers, and even live calculation blocks below it, so that this content sits outside the sheet’s declared structure. In the task LeaseorKeys (task 32, attempt 2319), live controls and calculations follow the inherited marker.
paragraphs.zh: “End Sheet”标记下方的内容。 在扩展继承的假设表时，模型保留其“End Sheet”标记，并在其下方追加新的控件、驱动因素，甚至实时计算块，使这些内容位于该表声明的结构之外。 在任务 LeaseorKeys（任务 32，尝试 2319）中，实时控件和计算位于继承的标记之后。

sents.en: Content below “End Sheet” markers.
sents.zh: “End Sheet”标记下方的内容。

sents.en: When extending an inherited assumptions sheet, the model keeps its “End Sheet” marker and appends new controls, drivers, and even live calculation blocks below it, so that this content sits outside the sheet’s declared structure.

sents.en: In the task LeaseorKeys (task 32, attempt 2319), live controls and calculations follow the inherited marker.
