paragraphs.en: Erratic row heights and misaligned text. The model occasionally generates tables whose body rows alternate between many custom heights, with tall detail rows, narrow spacer rows, and very tall outliers, and it sometimes aligns narrative text and labels to the right or centers them. For example, in the task MonthlyLiquidity (task 37, attempt 2365), body rows range from 18 to 62 points, with one row at 310 points, and in the task DoctorvsTrade (task 18, attempt 2077), the labels and narrative text on the summary are centered instead of left-aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 行高忽大忽小，文本对齐不一致。 模型偶尔会生成这样的表格：其正文行在多种自定义高度之间交替变化，出现很高的明细行、很窄的间隔行以及极高的异常行，有时还会把叙述性文本和标签右对齐或居中对齐。 例如，在任务 MonthlyLiquidity（任务 37，第 2365 次尝试）中，正文行的高度从 18 到 62 点不等，其中有一行高达 310 点；在任务 DoctorvsTrade（任务 18，第 2077 次尝试）中，摘要页面上的标签和叙述性文本被居中对齐，而不是左对齐。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT for Excel is a tidy, well-scaffolded builder that keeps its columns readable, sets print areas, and drives its timelines from start-date inputs, but it slips on several conventions: rounding labels, font colors, buffer rows above totals, a glossary, and lean schedules. Its drifting font colors and totals without buffer rows also mark both Claude for Excel agents (Fable 5.1 and Opus 5) and are thus likely effects of the Excel add-in harness; its readable column widths and complete print areas set it apart from them.
paragraphs.zh: ChatGPT for Excel 中的 GPT-5.6 Sol 是一个整洁、结构良好的构建器，它能保持列的可读性、设置打印区域，并根据开始日期输入驱动其时间线，但在若干惯例上有所疏漏：舍入标签、字体颜色、汇总上方的缓冲行、术语表以及精简的日程安排。 其漂移的字体颜色和缺少缓冲行的汇总同样出现在 Claude for Excel 的两个智能体（Fable 5.1 和 Opus 5）上，因此很可能是 Excel 加载项测试框架造成的影响；其可读的列宽和完整的打印区域则使它与二者区别开来。

paragraphs.en: Readable widths and print areas. The model wraps long narrative text instead of stretching columns, so that its own sheets stay within a readable width, and it usually defines a print area on every tab. This is evident in the task EasyDCF (task 20, attempt 1324), where no built column is excessively wide, and all long text is wrapped.
paragraphs.zh: 可读的列宽和打印区域。 该模型会对较长的叙述性文本进行换行而不是拉伸列，使其自身的表格保持在可读的宽度内，并且通常会在每个标签页上定义打印区域。 这在 EasyDCF 任务（任务 20，尝试 1324）中很明显，其中没有任何已构建的列过宽，且所有长文本都进行了换行。

paragraphs.en: Timelines driven by start-date inputs. The model usually builds the full required horizon in advance and drives period labels and dates from a central start-date and period input, so that the timeline can be rolled forward without edits to the formulas. In the task DebtFlow (task 15, attempt 1313), for instance, the full 30-year horizon is prebuilt with labels that follow the drivers.
paragraphs.zh: 由开始日期输入驱动的时间线。 该模型通常会预先构建完整所需的时间跨度，并从中央开始日期和期间输入来驱动期间标签和日期，这样无需修改公式即可将时间线向前滚动。 例如，在任务 DebtFlow（任务 15，尝试 1313）中，完整的 30 年时间跨度已预先构建，其标签跟随驱动因素。

sents.zh: 例如，在任务 DebtFlow（任务 15，尝试 1313）中，完整的 30 年时间跨度已预先构建，其标签跟随驱动因素。

paragraphs.en: Complete scaffold with a live summary. The model reliably delivers the full workbook skeleton: a summary as the first tab that doubles as a cover with owner, version, and date, followed by a table of contents, a check sheet, and a change log, and the figures on the summary are live formulas. The task CashConversionLab (task 6, attempt 1280) illustrates this: the values and check status on the summary link to the assumptions, working-capital, and check sheets.
paragraphs.zh: 带实时汇总的完整脚手架。 模型稳定地交付完整的工作簿骨架：第一个标签页是汇总表，兼作封面，包含负责人、版本和日期，其后是目录、核对表和变更日志，且汇总表上的数字均为实时公式。 任务 CashConversionLab（任务 6，第 1280 次尝试）说明了这一点：汇总表上的数值和核对状态链接到假设表、营运资本表和核对表。

sents.en: Complete scaffold with a live summary.
sents.zh: 带实时汇总的完整脚手架。

sents.en: The model reliably delivers the full workbook skeleton: a summary as the first tab that doubles as a cover with owner, version, and date, followed by a table of contents, a check sheet, and a change log, and the figures on the summary are live formulas.

paragraphs.en: Wrong rounding notes. The model routinely labels sheets as “rounded to $0.01” although the formulas keep full precision and only the display format is limited; on some tasks, it also wraps intermediate values in ROUND before they feed later calculations. For example, in the task BasicGrowth (task 2, attempt 1267), sheets are labeled “rounded to $0.01”, yet none of their roughly 9,900 formulas uses a rounding function.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的舍入备注。 该模型经常把表格标注为「已舍入到 0.01 美元」，尽管公式始终保持完整精度，只是显示格式受限；在某些任务中，它还会在中间值进入后续计算之前用 ROUND 函数将其包裹起来。 例如，在 BasicGrowth 任务（任务 2，第 1267 次尝试）中，表格被标注为「已舍入到 0.01 美元」，但其约 9,900 个公式中没有一个使用舍入函数。

sents.en: Wrong rounding notes.
sents.zh: 错误的舍入备注。

paragraphs.en: Unreliable font colors. In a fair number of tasks, the model colors same-sheet calculations green, the color its own legend reserves for cross-sheet links, and mixes black and green for the same kind of formula, so that the font color no longer reveals to the reader what type of cell it is. A case in point is the task RevForecast (task 49, attempt 1390), where same-sheet calculations are green in three columns and black in a fourth.
paragraphs.zh: 字体颜色不可靠。 在相当多的任务中，模型把同表计算标成绿色——这是它自己的图例中保留给跨表链接的颜色——并且对同一类公式混用黑色和绿色，导致字体颜色无法再向读者揭示单元格的类型。 一个典型例子是任务 RevForecast（任务 49，尝试 1390），其中同表计算在三列中为绿色，在第四列中为黑色。

sents.en: Unreliable font colors.
sents.zh: 字体颜色不可靠。

sents.en: In a fair number of tasks, the model colors same-sheet calculations green, the color its own legend reserves for cross-sheet links, and mixes black and green for the same kind of formula, so that the font color no longer reveals to the reader what type of cell it is.

sents.en: A case in point is the task RevForecast (task 49, attempt 1390), where same-sheet calculations are green in three columns and black in a fourth.
sents.zh: 一个典型例子是任务 RevForecast（任务 49，尝试 1390），其中同表计算在三列中为绿色，在第四列中为黑色。

paragraphs.en: No buffer rows above totals. The model puts totals directly below the last line item with fixed sum ranges, so that a row inserted above a total falls outside the sum. In the task Office (task 40, attempt 1366), total revenues and gross asset value sit directly below fixed SUM ranges, although every other agent satisfied this criterion on the task.
paragraphs.zh: 合计行上方没有缓冲行。 该模型将合计直接放在最后一个明细行下方，并使用固定的求和范围，因此插入到合计上方的行会落在求和范围之外。 在任务 Office（任务 40，第 1366 次尝试）中，总收入和总资产价值直接位于固定的 SUM 范围下方，尽管其他所有智能体都在该任务上满足了此标准。

sents.en: In the task Office (task 40, attempt 1366), total revenues and gross asset value sit directly below fixed SUM ranges, although every other agent satisfied this criterion on the task.

paragraphs.en: Oversized schedules that recalculate slowly. As the flip side of its prebuilt timelines, schedules run far past the active horizon, with thousands of mostly blank formula rows that SUMIFS, lookups, or whole-column references then rescan, which makes the recalculation load avoidably heavy. In the task PaydownPathways (task 42, attempt 1368), for instance, a schedule of 5,200 periods, only 180 of them active, is rescanned by every yearly SUMIFS, LOOKUP, and AVERAGEIFS row.
paragraphs.zh: 超大规模的排期表重算缓慢。 作为其预置时间线的另一面，排期表会远远超出活跃区间，包含数千行大多为空的公式行，随后被 SUMIFS、查找函数或整列引用反复扫描，这使得重算负担本可避免地变得沉重。 例如，在任务 PaydownPathways（任务 42，尝试 1368）中，一个包含 5,200 个期间（其中仅 180 个处于活跃状态）的排期表，会被每一个年度 SUMIFS、LOOKUP 和 AVERAGEIFS 行重新扫描。

sents.en: Oversized schedules that recalculate slowly.
sents.zh: 超大规模的排期表重算缓慢。

sents.en: As the flip side of its prebuilt timelines, schedules run far past the active horizon, with thousands of mostly blank formula rows that SUMIFS, lookups, or whole-column references then rescan, which makes the recalculation load avoidably heavy.
sents.zh: 作为其预置时间线的另一面，排期表会远远超出活跃区间，包含数千行大多为空的公式行，随后被 SUMIFS、查找函数或整列引用反复扫描，这使得重算负担本可避免地变得沉重。

sents.en: In the task PaydownPathways (task 42, attempt 1368), for instance, a schedule of 5,200 periods, only 180 of them active, is rescanned by every yearly SUMIFS, LOOKUP, and AVERAGEIFS row.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 PaydownPathways（任务 42，尝试 1368）中，一个包含 5,200 个期间（其中仅 180 个处于活跃状态）的排期表，会被每一个年度 SUMIFS、LOOKUP 和 AVERAGEIFS 行重新扫描。

paragraphs.en: No glossary of conventions. The cover and summary explain scope and usage but sometimes give no glossary for the color conventions and abbreviations, such as FCF, EAR, and $mm, although the house standards require one. For example, in the task SmallRiver (task 98, attempt 1546), neither the blue/black/green convention nor abbreviations such as FCF, EAR, and $mm are explained.
paragraphs.zh: 没有约定术语表。 封面和摘要说明了范围和用法，但有时没有给出颜色约定和缩写（如 FCF、EAR 和 $mm）的术语表，尽管机构标准要求提供。 例如，在任务 SmallRiver（任务 98，尝试 1546）中，蓝/黑/绿颜色约定以及 FCF、EAR 和 $mm 等缩写都没有得到解释。

sents.en: No glossary of conventions.
sents.zh: 没有约定术语表。

sents.en: The cover and summary explain scope and usage but sometimes give no glossary for the color conventions and abbreviations, such as FCF, EAR, and $mm, although the house standards require one.
sents.zh: 封面和摘要说明了范围和用法，但有时没有给出颜色约定和缩写（如 FCF、EAR 和 $mm）的术语表，尽管机构标准要求提供。

sents.en: For example, in the task SmallRiver (task 98, attempt 1546), neither the blue/black/green convention nor abbreviations such as FCF, EAR, and $mm are explained.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 SmallRiver（任务 98，尝试 1546）中，蓝/黑/绿颜色约定以及 FCF、EAR 和 $mm 等缩写都没有得到解释。

paragraphs.en: Grok 4.6 in Codex is a structurally tidy builder that names its key inputs, freezes its long sheets, and documents rounding carefully, but it clutters its sheets with merged cells, centered numbers, and boxed grids, fills its summary tabs with hardcoded numbers, and occasionally ships workbooks broken by #NAME? errors.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 中的 Grok 4.6 是一个结构整洁的构建者：它会标明关键输入、冻结其长工作表、仔细记录舍入方式，但它的表格中充斥着合并单元格、居中数字和带框网格，其汇总标签页中填满了硬编码数字，并且偶尔会交付因 #NAME? 错误而损坏的工作簿。

paragraphs.en: Named key inputs. The model almost always gives key global inputs, such as dates, rates, case selectors, and unit conversions, short and descriptive defined names. This is evident in the task EasyDCF (task 20, attempt 2353), where the Name Manager holds a full set of named DCF inputs, among them ValDate , Rf , Beta , MRP , and TaxRate .
paragraphs.zh: 命名的关键输入。 该模型几乎总是为关键的全局输入（如日期、比率、案例选择器和单位换算）使用简短且具有描述性的定义名称。 这在任务 EasyDCF（任务 20，尝试 2353）中很明显，其中名称管理器（Name Manager）保存了一整套命名的 DCF 输入，其中包括 ValDate、Rf、Beta、MRP 和 TaxRate。

sents.en: Named key inputs.
sents.zh: 命名的关键输入。

sents.en: The model almost always gives key global inputs, such as dates, rates, case selectors, and unit conversions, short and descriptive defined names.
sents.zh: 该模型几乎总是为关键的全局输入（如日期、比率、案例选择器和单位换算）使用简短且具有描述性的定义名称。

sents.en: This is evident in the task EasyDCF (task 20, attempt 2353), where the Name Manager holds a full set of named DCF inputs, among them ValDate , Rf , Beta , MRP , and TaxRate .
sents.zh: 这在任务 EasyDCF（任务 20，尝试 2353）中很明显，其中名称管理器（Name Manager）保存了一整套命名的 DCF 输入，其中包括 ValDate、Rf、Beta、MRP 和 TaxRate。

paragraphs.en: Freeze panes on long sheets. The model keeps titles, column headers, and period labels frozen at sensible positions on long calculation sheets. The task Proportionality (task 46, attempt 2377) illustrates this: the headers and labels of the long documentation and calculation sheets are frozen, and none of the freezes is excessive.
paragraphs.zh: 在长表格中冻结窗格。 该模型会在长计算表上将标题、列标题和期间标签冻结在合理的位置。 任务 Proportionality（任务 46，尝试 2377）说明了这一点：长文档表和计算表的标题与标签均已冻结，且没有一处冻结是过度的。

sents.en: Freeze panes on long sheets.
sents.zh: 在长表格中冻结窗格。

sents.en: The model keeps titles, column headers, and period labels frozen at sensible positions on long calculation sheets.
sents.zh: 该模型会在长计算表上将标题、列标题和期间标签冻结在合理的位置。

sents.en: The task Proportionality (task 46, attempt 2377) illustrates this: the headers and labels of the long documentation and calculation sheets are frozen, and none of the freezes is excessive.
sents.zh: 任务 Proportionality（任务 46，尝试 2377）说明了这一点：长文档表和计算表的标题与标签均已冻结，且没有一处冻结是过度的。

paragraphs.en: Honest rounding documentation. The model’s notes separate figures that are only “shown to” a precision from answers that are actually rounded with ROUND, and they sit next to the outputs. A case in point is the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2259), where the annual sheet reads “shown to $0.01m, full precision held”.
paragraphs.zh: 诚实的舍入说明文档。 模型的备注将仅仅“展示到”某一精度的数字与实际用 ROUND 进行舍入的答案区分开来，并且这些备注紧挨着输出结果。 一个典型案例是任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，尝试 2259），其中年度报表写着“展示到 0.01 百万美元，保留完整精度”。

sents.en: Honest rounding documentation.
sents.zh: 诚实的舍入说明文档。

sents.en: The model’s notes separate figures that are only “shown to” a precision from answers that are actually rounded with ROUND, and they sit next to the outputs.
sents.zh: 模型的备注将仅仅“展示到”某一精度的数字与实际用 ROUND 进行舍入的答案区分开来，并且这些备注紧挨着输出结果。

sents.en: A case in point is the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2259), where the annual sheet reads “shown to $0.01m, full precision held”.
sents.zh: 一个典型案例是任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，尝试 2259），其中年度报表写着“展示到 0.01 百万美元，保留完整精度”。

paragraphs.en: Merged cells and centered blocks. The model routinely merges sheet titles, section headers, and whole cover or summary blocks instead of using Center Across Selection, although the house standards prohibit merged cells, and it centers whole blocks of numbers in statements, schedules, and ratio tables as well as body paragraphs on the cover and summary. In the task CorpBond (task 10, attempt 2387), the cover contains 30 merged ranges and the summary 36, and in the task RoadtoZero (task 50, attempt 2329), long scope and methodology paragraphs are centered.
paragraphs.zh: 合并单元格和居中的区块。 该模型经常合并工作表标题、章节标题以及整个封面或汇总区块，而不使用跨列居中，尽管机构规范禁止合并单元格，并且它还会将报表、附表和比率表中的整块数字以及封面和汇总页的正文段落居中。 在任务 CorpBond（任务 10，尝试 2387）中，封面包含 30 个合并区域，汇总包含 36 个；在任务 RoadtoZero（任务 50，尝试 2329）中，较长的范围说明和方法论段落被居中了。

sents.en: Merged cells and centered blocks.
sents.zh: 合并单元格和居中的区块。

sents.en: The model routinely merges sheet titles, section headers, and whole cover or summary blocks instead of using Center Across Selection, although the house standards prohibit merged cells, and it centers whole blocks of numbers in statements, schedules, and ratio tables as well as body paragraphs on the cover and summary.
sents.zh: 该模型经常合并工作表标题、章节标题以及整个封面或汇总区块，而不使用跨列居中，尽管机构规范禁止合并单元格，并且它还会将报表、附表和比率表中的整块数字以及封面和汇总页的正文段落居中。

sents.en: In the task CorpBond (task 10, attempt 2387), the cover contains 30 merged ranges and the summary 36, and in the task RoadtoZero (task 50, attempt 2329), long scope and methodology paragraphs are centered.
sents.zh: 在任务 CorpBond（任务 10，尝试 2387）中，封面包含 30 个合并区域，汇总包含 36 个；在任务 RoadtoZero（任务 50，尝试 2329）中，较长的范围说明和方法论段落被居中了。

paragraphs.en: Boxed grids and oversized rows. The model inserts thin borders on all four sides of nearly every cell within large calculation blocks, which duplicates the gridlines and creates a dense grid, and it leaves the narrative and header rows much taller than necessary, some even several times the regular row height. For example, in the task MarketBalanced (task 35, attempt 2180), virtually every cell of the calculation engine is boxed, and in the task ConstantFlow (task 9, attempt 2249), a single row is 359.7 points tall.
paragraphs.zh: 边框网格与过高的行。 模型在大型计算区块中几乎每个单元格的四边都插入细边框，这与网格线重复并形成密集的网格，同时它把叙述行和标题行留得比必要高度高得多，有些甚至是常规行高的数倍。 例如，在任务 MarketBalanced（任务 35，尝试 2180）中，计算引擎的几乎每个单元格都加了边框，而在任务 ConstantFlow（任务 9，尝试 2249）中，单个行高达 359.7 点。

sents.en: Boxed grids and oversized rows.
sents.zh: 边框网格与过高的行。

sents.en: The model inserts thin borders on all four sides of nearly every cell within large calculation blocks, which duplicates the gridlines and creates a dense grid, and it leaves the narrative and header rows much taller than necessary, some even several times the regular row height.
sents.zh: 模型在大型计算区块中几乎每个单元格的四边都插入细边框，这与网格线重复并形成密集的网格，同时它把叙述行和标题行留得比必要高度高得多，有些甚至是常规行高的数倍。

sents.en: For example, in the task MarketBalanced (task 35, attempt 2180), virtually every cell of the calculation engine is boxed, and in the task ConstantFlow (task 9, attempt 2249), a single row is 359.7 points tall.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 MarketBalanced（任务 35，尝试 2180）中，计算引擎的几乎每个单元格都加了边框，而在任务 ConstantFlow（任务 9，尝试 2249）中，单个行高达 359.7 点。

paragraphs.en: Summaries with hardcoded numbers. The model often fills the summary tab with typed snapshot figures without formulas, so the summary never updates when inputs change. In the task Bosch (task 3, attempt 2088), for instance, the summary contains no formulas, and sales, margins, and balance-sheet figures are typed snapshots.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要中硬编码了数字。 模型经常在摘要工作表中填入手动输入的快照数值而不使用公式，因此当输入发生变化时摘要永远不会更新。 例如，在任务 Bosch（任务 3，尝试 2088）中，摘要不包含任何公式，销售额、利润率和资产负债表数字都是手动输入的快照。

sents.en: Summaries with hardcoded numbers.
sents.zh: 摘要中硬编码了数字。

sents.en: The model often fills the summary tab with typed snapshot figures without formulas, so the summary never updates when inputs change.
sents.zh: 模型经常在摘要工作表中填入手动输入的快照数值而不使用公式，因此当输入发生变化时摘要永远不会更新。

sents.en: In the task Bosch (task 3, attempt 2088), for instance, the summary contains no formulas, and sales, margins, and balance-sheet figures are typed snapshots.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 Bosch（任务 3，尝试 2088）中，摘要不包含任何公式，销售额、利润率和资产负债表数字都是手动输入的快照。

paragraphs.en: Deeply nested formulas. The model writes long, monolithic formulas that nest IF, INDEX/MATCH, or SMALL chains four or more levels deep, notably in hand-built percentile interpolation and growth formulas, and leaves them as single blocks even where helper rows already exist. This is evident in the task TMobile (task 57, attempt 2354), where a monolithic percentile formula chains IF, OR, ABS, INT, and SMALL, although helper rows exist.
paragraphs.zh: 深度嵌套的公式。 模型会写出冗长的单体式公式，将 IF、INDEX/MATCH 或 SMALL 链嵌套达四层或更深，尤其是在手工构建的百分位插值和增长公式中，并且即使辅助行已经存在，也仍将其保留为单个区块。 这在任务 TMobile（任务 57，尝试 2354）中表现明显，其中一个单体式百分位公式串联了 IF、OR、ABS、INT 和 SMALL，尽管辅助行已经存在。

sents.en: Deeply nested formulas.
sents.zh: 深度嵌套的公式。

sents.en: The model writes long, monolithic formulas that nest IF, INDEX/MATCH, or SMALL chains four or more levels deep, notably in hand-built percentile interpolation and growth formulas, and leaves them as single blocks even where helper rows already exist.

sents.en: This is evident in the task TMobile (task 57, attempt 2354), where a monolithic percentile formula chains IF, OR, ABS, INT, and SMALL, although helper rows exist.

paragraphs.en: Kimi K3 in Codex is an agent that gets parts of the workbook plumbing right, with working table-of-contents links, clean sheet separation, honest rounding notes, and compact rows, but unlike the frontier agents, it ships hardcoded summary tabs and unsourced assumptions; it also builds hard-wired timelines and leaves inherited clutter and half-applied style rules behind.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 中的 Kimi K3 是一个智能体，它能正确处理工作簿的部分基础工作：目录链接可用、工作表分离清晰、舍入说明诚实、行显示紧凑；但与前沿智能体不同的是，它交付了硬编码的汇总标签页和没有来源依据的假设；它还构建了写死的时间线，并遗留了继承下来的杂乱内容和只应用了一半的样式规则。

paragraphs.en: Honest rounding notes. The notes on the cover and sheets describe precision correctly: intermediate values carry full precision, most figures are only displayed to two decimals, and ROUND is applied to the answer cells alone. The task TBondII (task 56, attempt 2714) illustrates this: a note states that values are displayed to $0.01 and only the answers are rounded.
paragraphs.zh: 诚实的舍入说明。 封面和工作表上的说明正确地描述了精度：中间值保留完整精度，大多数数字仅显示到小数点后两位，而 ROUND 仅应用于答案单元格。 任务 TBondII（任务 56，尝试 2714）说明了这一点：一条说明指出数值显示到 $0.01，且只有答案被舍入。

sents.en: Honest rounding notes.
sents.zh: 诚实的舍入说明。

sents.en: The notes on the cover and sheets describe precision correctly: intermediate values carry full precision, most figures are only displayed to two decimals, and ROUND is applied to the answer cells alone.
sents.zh: 封面和工作表上的说明正确地描述了精度：中间值保留完整精度，大多数数字仅显示到小数点后两位，而 ROUND 仅应用于答案单元格。

sents.en: The task TBondII (task 56, attempt 2714) illustrates this: a note states that values are displayed to $0.01 and only the answers are rounded.
sents.zh: 任务 TBondII（任务 56，尝试 2714）说明了这一点：一条说明指出数值显示到 $0.01，且只有答案被舍入。

paragraphs.en: Working table of contents. The model puts HYPERLINK formulas to every worksheet on the cover or a separate contents tab. For example, in the task Bosch (task 3, attempt 2085), functional HYPERLINK formulas open every sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 可用的目录工作表。 模型在封面或单独的目录工作表上为每个工作表添加 HYPERLINK 公式。 例如，在 Bosch 任务（任务 3，尝试 2085）中，有效的 HYPERLINK 公式可以打开每个工作表。

sents.en: Working table of contents.
sents.zh: 可用的目录工作表。

sents.en: The model puts HYPERLINK formulas to every worksheet on the cover or a separate contents tab.
sents.zh: 模型在封面或单独的目录工作表上为每个工作表添加 HYPERLINK 公式。

sents.en: For example, in the task Bosch (task 3, attempt 2085), functional HYPERLINK formulas open every sheet.
sents.zh: 例如，在 Bosch 任务（任务 3，尝试 2085）中，有效的 HYPERLINK 公式可以打开每个工作表。

paragraphs.en: Clean functional sheet separation. The model keeps the cover, inputs, calculations, outputs, checks, and answers on separate sheets or in clearly labeled blocks and does not append content below an inherited “End Sheet” marker. A case in point is the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2662), where each function has its own sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 清晰的功能性工作表分离。 模型将封面、输入、计算、输出、检查和答案分别放在不同的工作表或标注清晰的区块中，并且不会在继承的「End Sheet」标记下方追加内容。 一个典型例子是任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，第 2662 次尝试），其中每个功能都有自己的工作表。

sents.en: Clean functional sheet separation.
sents.zh: 清晰的功能性工作表分离。

sents.en: The model keeps the cover, inputs, calculations, outputs, checks, and answers on separate sheets or in clearly labeled blocks and does not append content below an inherited “End Sheet” marker.
sents.zh: 模型将封面、输入、计算、输出、检查和答案分别放在不同的工作表或标注清晰的区块中，并且不会在继承的「End Sheet」标记下方追加内容。

sents.en: A case in point is the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2662), where each function has its own sheet.
sents.zh: 一个典型例子是任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，第 2662 次尝试），其中每个功能都有自己的工作表。

paragraphs.en: Compact rows. The model keeps the rows it builds at a sensible height; the only tall rows are inherited instruction rows. In the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2662), for instance, only the inherited instruction row reaches about 60 points; all other rows are lower.
paragraphs.zh: 压缩行高。 模型将其构建的行保持在合理的高度；唯一较高的行是继承的指令行。 例如，在任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，尝试 2662）中，只有继承的指令行达到约 60 点的高度；其他所有行都更低。

sents.en: Compact rows.
sents.zh: 压缩行高。

sents.en: The model keeps the rows it builds at a sensible height; the only tall rows are inherited instruction rows.
sents.zh: 模型将其构建的行保持在合理的高度；唯一较高的行是继承的指令行。

sents.en: In the task CashNiagara (task 7, attempt 2662), for instance, only the inherited instruction row reaches about 60 points; all other rows are lower.
sents.zh: 例如，在任务 CashNiagara（任务 7，尝试 2662）中，只有继承的指令行达到约 60 点的高度；其他所有行都更低。

paragraphs.en: Static summary tab. The tab named “Summary” is often typed narrative or a build plan without formulas, sometimes with input figures written into the prose, so nothing on it updates when inputs change. In the task DailyCash (task 13, attempt 2633), the summary consists only of hardcoded constants.
paragraphs.zh: 静态摘要标签页。 名为「Summary」的标签页通常是无公式的叙述性文字或构建计划，有时会把输入数字直接写进文字里，因此当输入变化时该标签页上的内容不会更新。 在任务 DailyCash（任务 13，第 2633 次尝试）中，摘要仅由硬编码的常量组成。

sents.en: Static summary tab.
sents.zh: 静态摘要标签页。

sents.en: The tab named “Summary” is often typed narrative or a build plan without formulas, sometimes with input figures written into the prose, so nothing on it updates when inputs change.
sents.zh: 名为「Summary」的标签页通常是无公式的叙述性文字或构建计划，有时会把输入数字直接写进文字里，因此当输入变化时该标签页上的内容不会更新。

sents.en: In the task DailyCash (task 13, attempt 2633), the summary consists only of hardcoded constants.
sents.zh: 在任务 DailyCash（任务 13，第 2633 次尝试）中，摘要仅由硬编码的常量组成。

paragraphs.en: Unsourced assumptions. Input blocks, and assumptions the agent adds itself, such as benchmarks, screening bands, forecast periods, and growth drivers, often carry no source citation and no judgment label with an owner and a date. The task TheLiquidityEngine (task 61, attempt 2972) illustrates this: the forecast-period, growth, averaging, and link assumptions have neither a source nor an owner or date.
paragraphs.zh: 无来源的假设。 输入模块，以及智能体自行添加的假设（例如基准值、筛选区间、预测期和增长驱动因素），通常既没有来源引用，也没有带负责人和日期的判断标签。 TheLiquidityEngine 任务（任务 61，尝试 2972）正说明了这一点：预测期、增长、平均和关联假设既没有来源，也没有负责人或日期。

sents.en: Unsourced assumptions.
sents.zh: 无来源的假设。

sents.en: Input blocks, and assumptions the agent adds itself, such as benchmarks, screening bands, forecast periods, and growth drivers, often carry no source citation and no judgment label with an owner and a date.
sents.zh: 输入模块，以及智能体自行添加的假设（例如基准值、筛选区间、预测期和增长驱动因素），通常既没有来源引用，也没有带负责人和日期的判断标签。

sents.en: The task TheLiquidityEngine (task 61, attempt 2972) illustrates this: the forecast-period, growth, averaging, and link assumptions have neither a source nor an owner or date.
sents.zh: TheLiquidityEngine 任务（任务 61，尝试 2972）正说明了这一点：预测期、增长、平均和关联假设既没有来源，也没有负责人或日期。

paragraphs.en: Hard-wired timelines. Timelines are often built from typed start dates, embedded years, constant year indices, or a fixed number of copied columns instead of flowing from one date or horizon driver, so rolling the model forward or changing its length requires manual edits. For example, in the task PastaInc (task 41, attempt 2596), a hardcoded first date is copied across 145 fixed monthly columns, and in the task ConstantFlow (task 9, attempt 2683), the engine is filled to exactly 300 columns and does not size itself from the model-length driver on the assumptions sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 硬编码的时间线。 时间线通常由固定格式的开始日期、内嵌的年份、常量年份索引或固定数量的复制列构成，而不是由某个日期或时间跨度驱动单元格动态生成，因此滚动模型或更改其长度都需要手动修改。 例如，在任务 PastaInc（任务 41，第 2596 次尝试）中，一个硬编码的起始日期被复制到 145 个固定的月度列中；在任务 ConstantFlow（任务 9，第 2683 次尝试）中，引擎恰好填满 300 列，并未根据假设表中的模型长度驱动单元格自动调整列数。

paragraphs.en: Own style conventions not applied. The model documents green as the color for cross-sheet links but leaves whole blocks of cross-sheet formulas in black, and it uses number formats that show negatives with a minus sign rather than in parentheses. This is evident in the task OperationsWeekly (task 95, attempt 2757), where whole aggregation blocks that link to the daily cash-flow sheet are black instead of the documented green.
paragraphs.zh: 未应用自有样式规范。 模型文档中规定绿色用于跨表链接，但将整块跨表公式留为黑色，并且使用的数字格式以负号而非括号显示负数。 这在任务 OperationsWeekly（任务 95，第 2757 次尝试）中很明显，其中链接到每日现金流表的整个汇总块是黑色，而不是文档中规定的绿色。

paragraphs.en: No freeze panes on large sheets. Long daily engines and very wide schedules usually have no frozen headers or label columns, and in one task, Kimi K3 even removed freeze panes that the input workbook already had. In the task LogisticsCategorization (task 34, attempt 2820), engines of 14,601 rows have no frozen header row.
paragraphs.zh: 大型工作表上没有冻结窗格。 很长的每日引擎和非常宽的日程表通常没有冻结的表头或标签列，而且在某个任务中，Kimi K3 甚至移除了输入工作簿中已有的冻结窗格。 在任务 LogisticsCategorization（任务 34，尝试 2820）中，14,601 行的引擎没有冻结的表头行。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash in Codex is a lean, bare-bones builder whose files stay compact and sensibly sized. However, it ships static summaries, rigid hardcoded timelines, a master error flag that can never turn red, builder-only documentation, unsourced assumptions, and unfrozen, over-boxed sheets.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 中的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是一个精简、极简的智能体，其文件保持紧凑且大小合理。 然而，它提供静态摘要、僵硬的硬编码时间线、永远无法变红的主错误标志、仅面向智能体的文档、无来源依据的假设，以及未冻结、过度加框的表格。

sents.en: However, it ships static summaries, rigid hardcoded timelines, a master error flag that can never turn red, builder-only documentation, unsourced assumptions, and unfrozen, over-boxed sheets.
sents.zh: 然而，它提供静态摘要、僵硬的硬编码时间线、永远无法变红的主错误标志、仅面向智能体的文档、无来源依据的假设，以及未冻结、过度加框的表格。

paragraphs.en: Sensible column widths and row heights. The model’s columns have a sensible width and its rows a normal height. In the task DailyDetail (task 77, attempt 2104), for instance, no built column is excessively wide.
paragraphs.zh: 合理的列宽和行高。 模型的列具有合理的宽度，行高也正常。 例如，在任务 DailyDetail（任务 77，第 2104 次尝试）中，没有任何已构建的列过宽。

paragraphs.en: Proportionate builds. The model sizes its schedules to the base case and avoids brute-force replication, such as copied WACC iteration blocks or thousands of prefilled spare rows, so its files stay proportionate to their content; the flip side is the rigid timelines listed below. A case in point is the task SpendingPlan (task 54, attempt 2095), where the workbook takes only 488 KB for a scenario dataset of 7,500 rows.
paragraphs.zh: 结构合理的构建。 模型将时间表规模控制在基础案例所需的范围内，避免暴力复制，例如复制的 WACC 迭代区块或数千行预填的备用行，使其文件与其内容保持相称；但代价是下面列出的僵硬时间线。 一个典型例子是任务 SpendingPlan（任务 54，第 2095 次尝试），其中工作簿对于 7,500 行的场景数据集仅占用 488 KB。

sents.en: Proportionate builds.
sents.zh: 结构合理的构建。

paragraphs.en: Totals clearly set off. Totals, subtotals, and closing balances are consistently bold, often with shading or double bottom borders. For example, in the task DetailedLoan (task 16, attempt 2113), totals and ending balances are bold and often shaded.
paragraphs.zh: 总计清晰区分标示。 总计、小计和期末余额始终使用加粗，并常配有底纹或双下边框。 例如，在任务 DetailedLoan（任务 16，尝试 2113）中，总计和期末余额均加粗且常带底纹。

paragraphs.en: Rigid, hardcoded timelines and drivers. Forecast years are typed labels and schedules are filled to a fixed length, so changing the start date, horizon, or payment frequency requires manual rework, and event months, thresholds, and weights are typed into formulas instead of being linked to a driver. The task DebtDeclineDynamics (task 14, attempt 2119) illustrates this: the engine is fixed at 60 periods and does not resize when the frequency or duration changes, and in the task Fixings (task 23, attempt 2112), the years 2026–2035 are typed labels, and the period count on the assumptions sheet does not drive the schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 僵化、硬编码的时间线与驱动因素。 预测年份是手动输入的标签，时间表被填充到固定长度，因此更改起始日期、预测期或付款频率都需要手动返工，而事件月份、阈值和权重是直接输入公式中的，而不是链接到某个驱动因素。 DebtDeclineDynamics 任务（任务 14，第 2119 次尝试）说明了这一点：引擎固定为 60 个周期，当频率或期限变化时不会调整大小；在 Fixings 任务（任务 23，第 2112 次尝试）中，2026–2035 年份是手动输入的标签，假设表上的周期数并不能驱动时间表。

paragraphs.en: Static summaries and check flags. The summary or cover is often a static build plan or narrative with almost no formulas, in which headline outputs, and even case inputs and dates, are retyped as constants; the master error flag on the check sheet has a static fill without conditional formatting, so a failing check can never trigger a visual alarm. This is evident in the task Proportionality (task 46, attempt 2158), where the summary holds 61 constants and no formulas, and in the task Bosch (task 3, attempt 2082), where the master flag has a static blue fill and no conditional formatting rule.
paragraphs.zh: 静态汇总与检查标志。 汇总页或封面往往是一份几乎不含公式的静态构建计划或叙述，其中核心输出、甚至案例输入和日期都被重新输入为常量；检查表上的主错误标志采用静态填充而没有条件格式，因此检查失败也永远无法触发视觉警报。 这在任务 Proportionality（任务 46，尝试 2158）中很明显，其汇总页包含 61 个常量且没有任何公式；在任务 Bosch（任务 3，尝试 2082）中也很明显，其主标志为静态蓝色填充且没有条件格式规则。

sents.en: Static summaries and check flags.

paragraphs.en: Formulas that break under plausible stress. Tax-rate, growth, and return formulas divide without a guard, so a plausible stress, such as pretax or net income falling to zero, throws #DIV/0! into the valuation, and some logic is pinned to fixed levels and misbehaves when an input is halved. In the task EasyDCF (task 20, attempt 2181), for instance, the unguarded ratio of tax to pretax income returns #DIV/0! when pretax income is stressed to zero, and the error flows into the average tax rate and the valuation.
paragraphs.zh: 在合理压力下会失效的公式。 税率、增长和回报公式在做除法时没有保护，因此一个合理的压力情形，例如税前利润或净利润降至零，就会把 #DIV/0! 带入估值中，而且某些逻辑被固定在特定水平上，当输入减半时就会出错。 例如，在任务 EasyDCF（任务 20，尝试 2181）中，未加保护的税额与税前利润之比在税前利润被压力测试压到零时会返回 #DIV/0!，且该错误会流入平均税率和估值中。

sents.en: Formulas that break under plausible stress.

paragraphs.en: Thin documentation and unsourced assumptions. The notes describe how the model was built, but not how to use it: there is almost never a guide to which inputs are safe to edit or where to read the outputs, scope notes omit exclusions, complex nested formulas carry no comments, and assumption blocks carry no source, owner, or date, even for the model’s own judgment calls. In the task BasicGrowth (task 2, attempt 2141), the navigation section only lists the tabs, and nothing explains which inputs are editable or how to use the compounding selector, and in the task BreakingDowntheBalance (task 4, attempt 2147), the input block has no source field and no owner or date for any driver.
paragraphs.zh: 文档单薄，假设缺乏来源。 说明文档描述了模型是如何搭建的，却没有说明如何使用它：几乎从来没有一份指南告诉你哪些输入可以安全地修改、到哪里去读取输出；范围说明遗漏了排除项；复杂的嵌套公式没有任何注释；假设部分没有来源、负责人或日期，即使对于模型自身的判断性设定也是如此。 在任务 BasicGrowth（任务 2，尝试 2141）中，导航部分只列出了各个标签页，没有任何内容说明哪些输入可以编辑，或者如何使用复利选择器；在任务 BreakingDowntheBalance（任务 4，尝试 2147）中，输入部分没有来源字段，任何驱动因素都没有负责人或日期。

sents.en: Thin documentation and unsourced assumptions.

paragraphs.en: Unfrozen, over-boxed, inconsistent sheets. The model almost never freezes panes or sets print areas, even on very long or wide calculation sheets, boxes every cell of long schedules in thin borders, switches fonts between its own Arial and the inherited Aptos Narrow, and is loose on color conventions. For example, in the task GermanLife (task 30, attempt 2125), a calculation sheet of about 155 rows by 80 columns has no frozen panes.
paragraphs.zh: 未冻结窗格、过度加边框、样式不一致的工作表。 该模型几乎从不冻结窗格或设置打印区域，即使是在非常长或非常宽的计算表上也是如此；它给长清单的每个单元格都加上细边框，字体在自己继承的 Arial 和 Aptos Narrow 之间来回切换，并且对颜色规范的使用也比较随意。 例如，在任务 GermanLife（任务 30，尝试 2125）中，一张约 155 行 × 80 列的计算表没有冻结窗格。

sents.en: Unfrozen, over-boxed, inconsistent sheets.
sents.zh: 未冻结窗格、过度加边框、样式不一致的工作表。

sents.en: The model almost never freezes panes or sets print areas, even on very long or wide calculation sheets, boxes every cell of long schedules in thin borders, switches fonts between its own Arial and the inherited Aptos Narrow, and is loose on color conventions.
